I could keep this short but id rather include all of the behaviour experienced. If you were a friend id say just dont do it to yourself, its fine to start with but then it changes.  The vast majority of items might be ok ,but the reports coming back saying the silvery as they call it is obviously dull due to high lead content. What's that got to do with anything, well its an indication of how they feel about you , if people sell you poisonous silver then they dont care about you in the slightest. Going back to my problems with them I purchased a rocking chair that was inferior in terms of quality and every day since the 28th I've gone to temu robots who send me to the seller then the seller sends me to temu and so on . 3 times on separate days over the last 6 days I've had stupid questions from the seller and deliberately no return every time I ask i get another stupid question, like would I accept a discount and keep it even though it's broken and inferior quality. This morning it was do you think 5 days is acceptable for the return, there just taking the p. Just so you all fully understand the assembly of this rocking chair is with nuts and bolts which are pressed into the end of an extremely thin metal tubes and one nut came lose and 2 metal tubes wer squashed so couldn't slot them together and had to be squashedback . Even though it was constructed it wasn't safe and the cushions were completely flat and you can feel the metal tubes through the lack of padding.  Out of all this nonsense its not purchasing it, its putting up with deliberate hindrance from the seller that makes my blood boil  so ill say it again if you dont like feeling helpless dont allow them to do this to you . I cant put you in  my shoes but trust me I can handle a lot in life like major operations but temu will destroy your buzz its like a legal black market but if you dont believe me do some research and you'll see exactly what I am talking about. All I want from them is my money but they are not giving me it back and stupidly think they can prevent my refund . If you hate telling people things that  they dont understand exactly what you are saying then you'll love temu , they typically say I totally understand and yet I just said to them please stop sending me messages till you have my return then they message me saying they understand and several more messages deliberately, and the more I ask them to stop the more they do it . It's like talking to irritating drunks that say they understand but they dont understand anything and then they have the cheek to ask for a rating when they haven't even done anything. And yes I do understand some of them  are robots but its just irritating having to listen to the same old rubbish from them and getting nowhere fast . The questions they asked me suggested that they didn't trust me either, saying things like some people purchased and then sent it back but tried to keep the credits that they earned  ,as for that promotion I tried it but it was extremely greedy and kept on wanting me to purchase hundreds of pounds worth of items when it distinctly said spend 60 to get back 30 so you cant even trust the promotions . Sadly I cant see the option to show images of the damage to the rocking chair on here for some reason.

Le problème avec Temu, c'est qu'il faut commander pour 20 euros minimum. Or, pour économiser sur les frais d'importation abusifs mis en place l'Europe, on commande dans la même catégorie d'objets. Et c'est compliqué d'atteindre les 20 euros. Si encore les frais d'importation de 3 euros étaient mis par colis, ce serait plus facile. Mais non, c'est par catégorie d'articles. Temu n'est pas responsable de ces frais d'importation, mais ce serait bien qu'il trouve très rapidement une parade. On ne peut plus se faire plaisir. De plus, on ne trouve sur Temu que des choses qu'on ne trouve pas sur d'autres sites en France (pour moi : manchons de bras originaux, accessoires et miniatures maison de poupées, etc...). J'ai une commande à passer, j'ai du mal à atteindre les 20 euros. Et parfois, pour une même catégorie d'articles, j'ai 6 euros de frais, et pas 3.

data.review_body: I regret that I cannot rate this company with zero or negative stars. Today, three of my orders were delivered to the wrong address. Despite clear evidence, Temu has refused to process a refund.The delivery photos clearly show my correct address printed on the envelopes, yet the proof-of-delivery pictures show the packages at an entirely different house on a different street. Furthermore, the proof-of-delivery photos showing the incorrect house were briefly removed from the Temu website under my order history. They were only restored after I informed customer service that I had already saved copies of this evidence.In addition to completely ignoring their own Purchase Protection Policy, Temu is actively attempting to deceive customers. I will be reporting this fraudulent behavior to the FTC.

I tried Temu and was happy with the price and what I ordered (over $300 of things)  However, some things I ordered did not fit or were not what I thought they would be. I knew that I would only receive one FREE return so I waited until I had received all of my things to make one return with a label. That's when the problem began. First of all, I didn't realize I had to go to the post office instead of UPS like I had done for one item returned with no hassle. I put 14 items in one box and got the label (snipped because it was so small) I took the label to the post office and they couldn't read it because the label was too small. I went to the Temu site and they said I'd have to cancel my 14 item return and return each item separately and pay for each to be shipped back because they couldn't find the label to send to my email. I copied the label I had into the chat along with the 14 items.  They had to confirm my identity to send another copy of the label. I went to my email and there was a response but no  label I sent a reply back and got a message that this is a no response email!  I found the label and will print it at work next week! What a hassle just for the $24 to be refunded to my debit card!  I'm happy that I got a lot of items for a really low cost, but the return process is not user friendly, especially if you don't have a printer or are returning more than one item. 
Temu also keeps sending you text and emails to give you "credit" for your orders, but you have to have a minimum of $10-$20 to get the credit. They say to choose gifts, but the gifts to choose from are things I already ordered!!! It's like gambling when you spin the wheel. It always lands on one thing, $100 credit and you have to spend that amount to get it! I've learned my lesson. If you are looking for cheap things and have plenty of money, Temu has them all, and it can be addictive! Don't try to return items. It's not worth the hassle. Check carefully before you buy an item in the reviews, size, and description of what it is made of. They're counting on you to just keep what you don't like or donate it! Ask yourself if you really need something. I'm happy that I got some things I really needed for cheap, but I'm not happy about the hassle to return items you don't like!

Bought an Ottoman bed. Item delivered in two packages a week apart. Reported poor quality on receipt of first package and accepted compensation for quality issue on some components. Second package contained assembly instructions and fittings. Instructions in German.Refused different language instructions by supplier as "Temu would not allow direct email contact". Complex to assemble and took significant time. On final assembly the gas struts supplied were found to be wrongly specified at 65kilo per struts. Industry standard 30 kilo. After a week of being passed around I purchased other struts myself and informed Temu. They now insist initial compensation was sufficient. Offered to initiate return for credit. By this time no packaging and unacceptable to invest even more work in disassembly. Cost of new struts about the same as compensation so now poor quality bed for full price. 
Very difficult to deal with company. Continual pass to another. Don't use this company.
data.review_headline: Bought an Ottoman bed from Temu

Compré en Temu varios sujetadores postoperatorios para llevarlos sin parar, tanto de día como de noche, durante un periodo prolongado tras una operación grave. ¡Dos de ellos llegaron húmedos, con mal olor y rastros de moho! ¡Y se trata de ropa interior, además de uso específico para el periodo postoperatorio, cuando los requisitos de higiene son especialmente estrictos! Envié una reclamación al servicio de atención al cliente, mencionando que ya no me quedaba tiempo para devolverlos, porque los necesitaba prácticamente de inmediato y durante mucho tiempo. En lugar de disculparse por el grave incumplimiento de las normas comerciales y de los derechos del consumidor, y de reembolsarme —ni siquiera hablo del precio total de los artículos defectuosos, sino al menos de los gastos de tratamiento contra el moho de la ROPA INTERIOR (!), me exigieron cinco veces seguidas que devolviera esos sujetadores, como si no escucharan mis argumentos de que no tenía tiempo para devolverlos. Un trato absolutamente grosero hacia una compradora de buena fe. Si, en respuesta a esta reseña mía, escriben su respuesta ESTÁNDAR de que me dirija al servicio de atención al cliente, pues bien: me he puesto en contacto cinco (¡!) veces para explicar mi situación y... ¡NINGUNA ATENCIÓN al cliente! A ellos solo les importa el dinero, y además sin ningún tipo de responsabilidad. ¡No respetan ni a los clientes ni a su propia reputación! ¡Un trabajo repugnante, una empresa repugnante!
PD sobre la respuesta de Temu: Y aquí tenéis la confirmación inequívoca de lo que os decía: sus respuestas son totalmente formales, sin ningún valor en cuanto a ayuda real: «sigue el enlace y busca tu pedido»; lo he hecho, lo he encontrado... ¡y nada más! Pero aparece marcado que, supuestamente, han respondido a la reclamación. Y así son el 99 % de los casos. ¡Qué horror, qué empresa tan espantosa!
data.review_headline: Un trabajo repugnante, una empresa repugnante!

data.review_body: Ihr Ticket-ID:1787755861013606 zu ihrer Information an mich, dass eine Erledigung meines Problems in 2 - 3 Tagen sein wird, ist für mich nicht nachvollziehbar. Ich fühle mich zum Narren gehalten. UPS als Zustell-Dienstleister steht für mich in der Pflicht die vertragliche Leistung - Lieferung bis zur Wohnungstür- zu erbringen. Da sich der Zusteller weigerte nochmals zu kommen, obwohl er vom Mitarbeiter des UPS Shops in Linz Einsteinstraße 5 darum gebeten und ihm mitgeteilt hat, dass ich sicher zu Hause bin, hat der Zusteller gegen die UPS  eigenen Richtlinien verstoßen. Die Vorgangsweise des Zustellers entspricht absolut nicht den UPS-Beförderungsrichtlinien. Es kann mir absolut nicht zugemutet werden ein sehr großes Paket, in dem die Ware schon 20 kg wiegt (mit Verpackung noch mehr) abzuholen. Sollte ich es nach Hause tragen oder mir irgendwo eine Sackkarre ausleihen?. Ich bin wirklich sehr, sehr verärgert und hatte mir eine raschere Lösung von TEMU erwartet. Bisher war es eine gute Zusammenarbeit mit dem Kundendienst. Doch bei der letzten Lieferung hat der Paketdienstleister UPS geschlampt und auch eine falsche Auskunft gegeben. Indem er behauptet hatte, das ordnungsgemäß an die Lieferadresse zugestellt wurde. Das war gelogen. TEMU liegt die Unterlage vor, aus der ersichtlich ist, dass das Paket vom UPS-Fahrer in einem Paketshop deponiert und nicht an meine Adresse zugestellt wurde. Auch in der Paketverfolgung ist ersichtlich, dass es im Paketshop deponiert wurde. data.review_body:
⭐ 1/5 — No hay transparencia. Para mí, esta ha sido la última vez que compro en Temu.

No es la primera vez que tengo problemas con Temu, pero después de esta experiencia, **sí será la última**.

Lo más grave no es solamente el dinero pendiente, sino la **falta de transparencia durante todo el proceso**.

Realicé una compra seleccionando productos que aparecían como disponibles en **almacén local**. Sin embargo, después de realizar el pago, aparecieron importes que aparentemente corresponden a **tasas de exportación**. Si un producto se ofrece como procedente de un almacén local, considero totalmente razonable que el consumidor pueda saber, antes de pagar, si existe alguna tasa adicional y exactamente por qué se aplica.

El problema es que **la información del importe final y de las tasas no se presentó de una manera suficientemente clara antes de efectuar el pago**. De hecho, tuve que comprobar la aplicación de mi banco para saber exactamente cuánto había sido debitado de mi tarjeta.

La compra fue cancelada y el importe total que salió de mi tarjeta fue de **83,09 €**. Pero el reembolso se está realizando de forma fragmentada:

**55,00 € + 5,71 € + 3,85 € = 64,56 €**

Por lo tanto, **todavía faltan 18,53 € por devolver**.

Y aquí empieza otra parte del problema: en lugar de existir un proceso de reembolso claro, con un desglose sencillo que permita al cliente comprobar qué está recibiendo y qué falta, tengo que hacer las cuentas por mi cuenta y tratar de averiguar dónde está el resto de mi dinero.

También tenía un **crédito de 16 €** que la propia Temu me había concedido anteriormente porque una mercancía no llegó conforme a lo acordado. Ese crédito es independiente de este reembolso y no puede utilizarse para justificar que no se devuelva íntegramente el dinero de esta compra.

Respecto al argumento de que puede haber diferentes tiempos de procesamiento bancario, lo entiendo perfectamente. Pero una cosa es el tiempo que tarda el banco en reflejar un reembolso y otra muy distinta es **qué importe ha decidido reembolsar Temu**. Son cuestiones diferentes.

Mi tarjeta fue debitada por **83,09 €**. Hasta ahora han regresado **64,56 €**. La diferencia es **18,53 €**. Los números son claros.

No estoy pidiendo un favor, una compensación ni dinero adicional. **Estoy reclamando mi propio dinero.**

Lo mínimo que espero de una plataforma del tamaño de Temu es transparencia: saber cuánto voy a pagar antes de confirmar una compra, conocer claramente qué impuestos o tasas se están aplicando y recibir un reembolso completo y fácilmente verificable cuando una compra se cancela.

En mi caso, ha ocurrido exactamente lo contrario: **cobro poco transparente, posibles tasas de exportación en artículos que figuraban como de almacén local y un reembolso dividido en varios importes que no permite saber fácilmente qué ha ocurrido con el dinero restante.**

Después de varias experiencias insatisfactorias, esta situación ha sido el límite.

**Temu: no se trata de 18,53 €. Se trata de confianza. Y cuando el cliente tiene que descubrir los cargos a través de la aplicación de su banco y hacer las cuentas para averiguar cuánto de su propio dinero falta, la confianza desaparece.**

Para mí, esta ha sido la última vez.

I have been shopping at TEMU since it began. I don’t usually have many problems today. It wasn’t really a problem. I just found it really amusing.

⭐⭐⭐ 3/5 — "Not for the toilet! An honest, accessible review of a budget find"

Title: Not for the toilet — and that’s just the start! 🚫🚽

Review:
I am registered blind and use specialised audible screen-reading software, so clear labelling and straightforward descriptions matter enormously to me. When this arrived marked "EAU DE TOILETTE" — literally "toilet water" — I genuinely thought it was a toilet spray! That’s confusing language if you don’t know it’s old-fashioned French for aftershave/cologne — and a real barrier for anyone with low vision or learning difficulties.

What it is: Men’s eau de toilette / aftershave spray — 30ml, neat little bottle, travels well.
The good:

• ✅ Nice fresh scent — not overpowering, pleasant to wear

• ✅ Decent longevity — lasts a few hours on skin

• ✅ Handy 30ml size — perfect for pocket or travel

• ✅ Simple spray mechanism — easy to use one-handed

• ✅ Great value — very affordable

What could be better:

• ❌ "Eau de Toilette" — confusing terminology! Why not just say "Aftershave" or "Cologne"?

• ❌ "BEHAVER" — spelling error on the box! Should be "Behaviour" — looks unprofessional

• ❌ No braille, no large-print text — hard to read for partially sighted users

• ❌ Scent not described anywhere — you have to guess or open it

• ❌ Made in China — no UK contact details listed

Bottom line:
It’s a perfectly decent budget aftershave — just don’t put it in the toilet! 😄 It’s a fun, affordable find — but the packaging and labelling really need simplifying for it to be accessible to everyone. If they fixed the language and added clear descriptions, it would be brilliant.

Would I recommend it? Yes — for the price, absolutely — just be aware it’s basic and the labels are confusing!

Bob’s Verdict: ⭐⭐⭐ — Decent smell, daft packaging, great price. Spray on your neck, not the loo! 🚫🚽
data.review_headline: Smell is great perfect for the price

data.review_body:
**Recensione Temu: Esperienza pessima, servizio clienti deludente e prodotti di scarsa qualità**

**Valutazione:** 1/5 ★☆☆☆☆

La mia esperienza con Temu è stata estremamente negativa e mi spinge a sconsigliare vivamente questa piattaforma.

Il problema più grave ha riguardato la gestione del pagamento. Trattandosi di un ordine dal valore consistente, ho scelto e completato l'acquisto selezionando l'opzione del pagamento a rate con PayPal, puntualmente approvata. Con mia grande sorpresa, la piattaforma mi ha addebitato l'intero importo in un'unica soluzione. Per cercare di risolvere l'accaduto ho dovuto aprire una contestazione formale. Dalla mia banca ho poi avuto conferma ufficiale che l'errore e l'intoppo informatico sono stati causati direttamente da Temu, che ha dimostrato una totale incapacità nel gestire la transazione in modo corretto.

A rendere la situazione ancora più frustrante è stato un servizio clienti a dir poco inesistente e inadeguato. Cercare un supporto reale è un'impresa impossibile: a fronte di comunicazioni chiare ed esaustive sui problemi riscontrati, le risposte ricevute dal sistema e dagli operatori sono state del tutto fuori luogo, generiche e prive di qualsiasi utilità pratica, dimostrando una completa mancanza di rispetto nei confronti del cliente.

A questo quadro già deludente si aggiunge la pessima qualità della merce ricevuta. Le descrizioni dei prodotti presenti sul sito si sono rivelate del tutto inaccurate e fuorvianti rispetto alla realtà: gli articoli arrivati sono di fattura estremamente scadente e di qualità squallida.

In conclusione, sconsiglio caldamente di effettuare acquisti su Temu, soprattutto per importi elevati. L'assenza di un'assistenza clienti reale, la inaffidabilità nella gestione dei pagamenti e la scarsa qualità dei prodotti rendono gli acquisti su questo sito un rischio inutilmente alto.

data.review_body:
This is the most untrustworthy company in the Internet!
My biggest complain aside to the every single detail from false advertisement to length in which the order is delivered is the RETURN WINDOW. They claim the client has 90 days in which to return the product but this is NOT TRUE TO BE as the 90 days start counting from the day you placed the order and NOT when you actually receive the product! 
Think about it.....how can you possible call in any claim, damage, or whatever shortfall with the order if YOU HAVENT RECEIVED THE ITEMS FIRST????This is evil and purely wrong doing! Then you call in and the service agents escalate the issue (typically with a pissed customer like me) only to rephrase and tell me they cannot do anything because the window had passed  when in fact if something was ordered on May 25th but received June 8th, I would have still be in time to complain because how was I going to complain on something I had not received!!! 
I will outline the cons to the best of my ability in a simple manner:
1.- Most items are grossly misrepresented. For example the image is 3 d of a real linen outfit with embroidery and what you get is a "printed version". It doesn't  matter if they write "print"  in the description if they don't ultimately change the image to reflect exactly what it is they're selling.
2.- Sizing charts are more in tune with asian models than with the average woman in the rest of the non asian world.
3.-Their site is "all over the place!" it doesn't matter what it is you're looking for, the algorithm will populate whatever it wants which is not necessarily objective towards your search criteria.
4.- 90 day return window policy is AN ABSOLUTE  LIE. Always keep in mind that the days start counting since the date you place the order AND NOT WHEN YOU RECEIVE THE ITEM which in many cases will take more than a month to receive.
5.- They NEVER USE BOXES FOR SHIPPING! I placed an order for 153 items and they placed most of them in a big bag. Needless to say half the items were damaged in transit due to extremely poor packaging. As an example, I ordered 30 packs of gold leaf sheets for gilding; when I opened the first block they were all bent and therefore unable to be used because of the bends. This is such a delicate material that breaks upon any bend; you can imagine what it looked like after I attempted to turn the pages... they were all teared and many pulverized!
6.- The misrepresentation of many items I consider to be deliberate and the "faulty" use of the English language is being used as a source for "playing dumb" when a problem arises and the sellers can cover themselves under the umbrella that "they don't understand or cannot read English properly."
7.-The credits and so called "discounts" are very complicated to understand how they populate and the site is overly dense in showing a discount one minute on an item and giving you another price for the same item at the time of checkout. The count on the fact that you won't use the credits they give you because they expire in a very, very short time, so unless they give you back your money in the same form of payment, simply DO NOT accept credits unless you'll be using them the same day they provide it, otherwise your money and credits will be forever lost
8.- Many vendors DO NOT LIST SIZES NOR DIMENSIONS either in the description nor in the images. This is absolutely necessary in order to best assess what you're buying. 
9.-Seldom are the REAL MATERIALS TRUTHFULLY OUTLINED IN THE DESCRIPTION NOR IN THE TITLE OF AN ITEM. As an example; I purchased 2 of what described as  "REAL LEATHER CROSSBODY BAG" only to receive 2 nice knock off bags made out of PU leather which is really not leather but a poly urethane coating on canvas giving the bag a super short lifespan; especially if you live in the tropics like I do. The same issue: another time The description was Linen 2 piece suit and what I received was polyester with a print of linen that in no way resembled what I ordered.

Pros...
I was going to say it's cheap. It actually has not been cheap for a very long time now. their 0.86ç items have completely defaced,....their once $2 are now $5 and you need to pay for S&h if you order little. I have to say that I am so very distraught by the lack of this company's ethics, that I am suggesting to go elsewhere. There is a place that basically mimics the items they have in Temu's website.At  Am.... Haul there is a minimum order of $25.00 but you get Amazon's reliable service even when from a 3rd party seller! You can't beat this! they are also incredibly truthful in their description and overall in their entire listings and the sales are much , much better than through TEMU. Whatever you choose to do; DO NOT E V E R buy from TEMU! at least until they take corrective measures that make them understand what it means to have & keep a repeat customer in the USA.
data.review_headline: Unreliable, Misleading, Grossly Misrepresenting & Terrible Return Policy!

data.review_body:
Okay quality/cheap products

I have ordered literly 100+ products from Temu over the last 2 years.

Temu is all about what vender you order from and what you are expecting. If you are expecting HIGH quality products, this isn't the place. However, if you understanding you are paying for cheaper quality products at a ridiculously low price, it is a great option. Many of the products you can find on Amazon, you can find on Temu for a much cheaper price and they are likely the same product. You can also find cheaper versions if many popular products, albeit, maybe at a lower quality. I have bought many women's swim suits and dresses from Temu and have had great luck with swimsuits being good quality and mixed experience on dresses. My advice is pay attention to individual sellers ratings on Temu and also pay attention to the material the products are listed under. I would stay away from anything 100% polyester as it is likely to be cheap quality. The quality of cotton/elastane products though, I have had great luck with (in regards to dresses, skirts, blouses, and swimsuits).

Bottom line: You can find a lot of Amazon quality products for a much cheaper price than Amazon. I presume a lot of the vendors are getting the products from the same place in China but obviously Amazon is marking them up whereas Temu venders a lot of the time are not. 

Temus return policy is amazing. Full refund with no fuss with drop off shipping, no cost returns. Honestly cannot get any better service on returns. Sometimes they do not even require you to return the item to get a full refund.

5/5 no hassle returns.

Leider ist ein Kauf bei Temu nicht mehr lohnend.
Bis vor ein paar Monaten habe ich gerne z.B. Schreibwarenartikel, Bastelartikel oder kleine Küchenartikel dort eingekauft, das ist nun vorbei:
Zum Einen hat Temu die Preise und die Mindestbestellsumme deutlich erhöht und zum Anderen, sind die zu zahlenden Zollabgaben zu hoch geworden.

Temu behauptet auf seinen Seiten selbst 80 Prozent der Zollabgaben zu tragen, das trifft ganz sicher gar nicht zu!!!

Mit drei Artikeln aus drei verschiedenen Warengruppen wie:
Schreibwarenartikel, Wohndeko, Bastelbedarf und einem Gesamtwert von 30,00 Euro wird mir und zwar erst ganz zum Schluss!!! bei Bestellabschluss eine Zollgebühr in Höhe von 14,95 Euro angezeigt.

Außerdem wird die Menge der Artikel im Warenkorb ungewollt erhöht (vor allem wenn man zwischendurch mal  die Seite verlässt z.B. statt 1 x wird da 2 x angezeigt, sodass man erheblich aufpassen muss, was im Warenkorb angezeigt wird, Stichwort "DARK PATTERNS". Das fiel mir erst in der Endsumme im letzten Bestellschritt auf....

Da vergeht mir die Lust am Kauf bei Temu deutlich! Ich habe alles aus dem Warenkorb gelöscht.

So ist Temu (auch Shein und Co.) mit Artikeln die beim Kauf aus China importiert werden müssen, für mich keine Option mehr. Und wer mit DARK PATTERNS arbeitet, hat ohnehin mein Vertrauen verspielt.

Da kaufe ich die gleichen Artikel bei anderen Onlineshops lieber etwas teurer aber immer noch viel günstiger als bei Temu und vermeide Ausgaben von denen ich rein gar nichts habe.

Das wars dann-----Tschüss Temu!

Nun möchte Temu heute gegen die Bewertung vorgehen und verlangt Verifizierungen, sonst Löschung der Bewertung.....lässt ja tief blicken!

data.owner_reply: Hoi, bedankt dat je shopt op Temu! Onze excuses dat niet alle artikelen aan je verwachtingen voldoen, we waarderen je feedback. We hanteren strikte beleids- en controlemaatregelen om de productkwaliteit en accurate productbeschrijvingen te garanderen. Als je niet tevreden bent met de artikelen die je hebt ontvangen, kun je binnen 90 dagen na aankoop je geld terugvragen. Temu-aankoopbescherming biedt volledige terugbetaling als je artikelen niet aankomen, beschadigd zijn of niet overeenkomen met de beschrijving of foto's (https://www.temu.com/temu-purchase-protection.html). Om een terugbetaling aan te vragen, log je in op de Temu-app of Temu.com met het account dat je hebt gebruikt voor je bestelling, open je de pagina "Mijn bestellingen" en klik je op "Retourneren / terugbetalen". Ga voor uitgebreide instructies naar https://www.temu.com/return-and-refund-policy.html. De eerste retourzending voor elke bestelling is gratis en je kunt ervoor kiezen je geld terug te storten op de oorspronkelijke betaalmethode of als Temu-tegoed. Temu-tegoed verschijnt binnen 3 minuten op je Temu-tegoedsaldo en kan direct worden gebruikt. Als je ervoor kiest je geld terug te storten op je oorspronkelijke betaalmethode, houdt er dan rekening mee dat het 5-14 werkdagen kan duren voordat het geld wordt teruggestort, vanwege verwerkingstijd bij je financiële instelling (dit kan tot 30 dagen in beslag kan nemen). Als je hulp nodig hebt, stuur ons dan een bericht via de livechat op Temu.com of de Temu-app. Vriendelijke groeten, Team Temu

Due to many purchases, Temu will tell you they will reduce your cart total by an amount and actually show you how much this is, or what you have earned - IT'S ALL A LIE!

I was then given the option to have the £17 deposited into my PayPal account, or receive as credits on Temu.
I requested for PayPal.  This process would NOT work and a security number would not text to my phone - no matter how much I tried!
So yes, you guessed it, the remaining option was for the credit on my Temu account.  When I selected this, it actually showed as many credits of 38p to apply to my next purchases one at a time..... Good Grief, what a flippin SCAM!!!
Like someone else has said, Negative Stars would represent better for the Temu special offers!
Don't be fooled and pulled in would be my advice.

Ce genre de traitement est extrêmement décevant. Quand un service client confirme quelque chose par écrit, on s’attend simplement à ce que cet engagement soit respecté.

Je déconseille fortement tant que le problème n’est pas résolu.

data.review_body: Waren früher die Bestellungen und Lieferungen ohne Probleme mit DHL oder Hermes möglich, wartet man heute vergeblich auf seine Bestellung. Der Versuch über JT Express eine Zustellung zu erreichen schlug fehl und wurde mehr als eine Woche nicht zugestellt. Unsere Adresse hat sich nicht geändert, allerdings sollte man die Straße auch in der richtigen Stadt suchen, sonst ist es natürlich zum Scheitern verurteilt. Den Kundendienst von Temu kontaktiert und auch hier keine Unterstützung erhalten. Geld sollte dann wieder als Guthaben verrechnet werden. Nach einem unheimlich langen 2ten Kontakt und mit ganz viel Geduld mit dem Kundendienst von Temu, endlich die Lösung. Das Geld ist nun wieder auf meinem Konto. Das bedurfte allerdings auch den mehrmaligen Hinweis, das ich keine neue Bestellung aufgeben werden und mir deshalb auch kein Guthaben nutzt (Ware kommt ja eh nicht an) wurde mein Geld zurück überwiesen. Leider ist eine Sicherstellung mit Versanddienstleister DHL nicht möglich, man bleibt beim grottenschlechten JT Express, und somit ist auch eine weitere Warenbestellung nicht möglich. Meinen angefangenen Pullover kann ich nun in die Tonne geben, da die restliche Wolle leider nicht ankommt. Nun ja, vielleicht entscheidet sich temu ja doch irgendwann wieder die regulären Kosten für kompetente Versanddienstleister auszugeben. Wir werden sehen.

FORMAL COMPLAINT & COMPREHENSIVE PUBLIC REVIEW
​Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆ (1/5) — Gross Misconduct, Systemic Stalling & Complete Lack of Support
​Title: Severe Agent Misconduct, Systemic Phone Support Blockade, and Disregard for Customer Health
​Review Body:
​If you are considering shopping on Temu, be fully aware of the customer support reality. The live chat system and support management are completely broken, operate on endless stalling scripts, and show zero regard for customer well-being or basic human decency.
​Systemic Phone Support Blockade: After automated emails explicitly instructed me to request a phone call via the app, the system repeatedly blocked my number with automated error messages stating a call was already logged. Despite providing proof of this error on screen, representative Maverick Harris—along with previous agents Kairos Rutledge and Elmira—refused to manually override or escalate the callback request, effectively trapping me on a live chat line for hours.
​Severe Misconduct & Medical Distress: Despite explicitly documenting medical distress and prescription medication requirements that required rest, these agents continued to use deflecting, scripted responses to run down the clock. They intentionally kept me awake past 2:30 AM and into the next morning with zero resolution, actively worsening my health condition.
​Lack of Escalation & Management Oversight: There is no functional management oversight. Agents continuously send generic, canned copy-paste scripts asking for details already visible in the system, ignoring direct complaints, refusing to transfer to senior operations, and failing to uphold basic customer care standards.
​Conclusion:
Because of the severe misconduct by Kairos Rutledge, Elmira, and Maverick Harris, I have cancelled all remaining incoming orders for full refunds and am permanently closing my Temu account. Customer support on this platform is a nightmare—shop elsewhere.

data.review_body:
Die große Betrugsplattform TEMU & Händler „FURNITURE OF

Ich habe über die Plattform TEMU ein Sofa der Firma FURNITURE OF bestellt. Die Lieferung erfolgte in drei separaten Paketen mit jeweils ca. 25–30 kg. Nach Prüfung des Artikels machte ich von meinem Widerrufsrecht Gebrauch und verlangte – entsprechend der tatsächlichen Versandart – drei Rücksendelabels.
Trotz mehrfacher schriftlicher Aufforderung über einen Zeitraum von nunmehr über zwei Wochen verweigert der Händler die Bereitstellung der erforderlichen Rücksendelabels. Dies steht in klarem Widerspruch zu der von TEMU beworbenen kostenlosen Rücksendung.
Auch der Versuch, den TEMU‑Käuferschutz in Anspruch zu nehmen, blieb erfolglos: TEMU verweigert die Ausstellung der drei notwendigen Rücksendelabels und verweigert zugleich die Rückerstattung des Kaufpreises. Damit wird der Käufer faktisch daran gehindert, sein gesetzliches Widerrufsrecht ordnungsgemäß auszuüben.
Dieses Verhalten erfüllt nach meinem Eindruck die Voraussetzungen einer systematischen Vereitelung der Rückabwicklung, was rechtlich höchst bedenklich ist. Der Kunde bleibt auf Sperrgut, erheblichen Gewichten und einem nicht erstatteten Kaufpreis sitzen.
Fazit: Für Möbel, Sperrgut oder großvolumige Waren ist TEMU – insbesondere der Händler FURNITURE OF – nicht vertrauenswürdig. Die beworbene „kostenlose Rücksendung“ wird faktisch nicht umgesetzt. Ich rate dringend davon ab, dort Möbel oder schwere Artikel zu bestellen.

AVOID AVOID AVOID!!

Where do I start with this awful, incompetent company?
In May 2026, I ordered €123 worth of goods from them, when the box arrived, it wasn’t security packaged half of the type of hanging off, I couldn’t even question it with the courier because it was left outside my door, but I took photos.  Anyway, turns out 5 of the items I ordered were missing., when I called the company to ask if those items were still in transit, I was told no, everything was in the same, and while I was on the phone to them apparently they went to check their CCTV in the huge warehouse and were able to tell me that those items were definitely placed in the box and because of that they refused to credit or refund me.  I opened a PayPal dispute which went in my favour for the cost of €55.23..
Fast forward 3 weeks, I wanted to return 5 items of clothing that were too big for me,(50.10)  it took forever for a return label to be sent to me because for some reason they were getting confused about the PayPal refund and could not understand why it was issued… eventually I was able to return said items on 20th of July. 23rd of July I get an email to tell me a refund has been processed., it is now 27th of August and the refund-which should’ve been made by PayPal as that that was how I paid-still hasn’t showed up  PayPal told me it hasn’t been processed through them because I would’ve had it almost immediately. 
So upon my complaint to Temu, they requested every single bank statement from Me from May to the present day, to confirm I didn’t get the refund… I wasn’t very happy but I had nothing to hide so I sent these in.
For the last 4 days I have been asking for the exact date of this apparent refund was processed,  had the same exact copy and paste  email back, telling me they have now issued the refund, but they refused to tell me the date it was processed, keep telling me to go to the financial Institute, but PayPal still have no record of the refund being processed.
I couldn’t initiate another PayPal dispute because the window of 4 weeks had long since closed.
I am now asking my bank for a chargeback because I am within 120 day window of that.

The stress of dealing with this company has just been ridiculous, it’s just not worth it, and the quality of the items are absolutely shocking anyway.

data.review_body: This company offers a lot of inexpensive products, but you have to be careful with how you shop. Every time I ordered something with very few or no reviews, the results were generally disappointing. I personally always buy each item individually, which means I pay the three dollars shipping per item, but this guarantees free shipping and a refund of the shipping I paid for if I choose to send the item back. Generally speaking, items with a good number of reviews will generally not disappoint, but keeping in mind the old saying: if something is too good to be true, it probably is.

data.review_body:
They have endless promotions when you open the app, but don't honor their promotion prices. They will promise to give you a rebate or a coupon if you purchase a certain number of items...after you do they won't honor it and will tell you, you have to buy more to recieve the discount. They were advertising shoes for $4 to $6 with free shipping. After I bought the items on sale, they jacked the price up to $15 and added shipping. I asked the customer representative and showed screenshot. She said the deal was timed. I told her I had purchased it and checked out within that time. She still said it was justified to triple the price after I had checked out and charge shipping. I requested a refund. They said they wouldn't give the money back for a week. 

Oh yeah, and if they fill out a ticket, you'll get an email explaining their representives are intelligent and its YOUR fault something went wrong. This goes against their quality and shipping "guaranteed" policies. The representative told me to get a video camera and find my packages on my own. 

Update: After Trust Pilot review Temu contacted me and told me it was my fault. They admitted the promotional price is not what they charge and their prices are higher in the cart. They told me please be more careful about my choices.

Ho provato a dare una possibilità a Temu, ma se ci fossero 0 stelle darei 0 stelle.

Il mese scorso ho effettuato diversi acquisti e, al di là della qualità molto bassa di gran parte dei prodotti ricevuti, ciò che mi ha deluso davvero è stata l’assistenza clienti.

Ho acquistato delle sdraio che avrei voluto restituire, ma ad oggi ho dovuto tenermele perché non sono riuscita a completare il reso. Ho trovato il servizio estremamente disorganizzato e poco efficiente.

Non voglio fare paragoni con altre piattaforme, ma oggi l’assistenza è un valore aggiunto fondamentale: dovrebbe farti sentire tranquillo nell’acquisto. In questo caso, invece, mi ha convinta a non comprare mai più da loro.

Personalmente preferisco spendere qualcosa in più e acquistare in Italia o presso negozi affidabili, piuttosto che ritrovarmi senza un supporto adeguato in caso di problemi.

Per me è stata la prima e sarà anche l’ultima esperienza con Temu.

Alla fine ho dovuto tenermi le sdraio, perché loro non sono stati in grado di riprendersele. Sono orrende! bassissima qualità

data.owner_reply: Hej, tack för att du handlar på Temu! Din feedback är extremt värdefull för oss och vi är ledsna att du inte är nöjd med några utav dina produkter. Vi implementerar strikta policyer och kontrollåtgärder för att säkerställa produktkvalitet och korrekta produktbeskrivningar. Om du inte är nöjd med någon av de produkter du fått, kan du ansöka om återbetalning inom 90 dagar efter köpet. Den första returen för varje beställning är gratis och du kan välja att få din återbetalning tillbaka till din ursprungliga betalningsmetod eller som Temu-krediter. Temu-krediter kommer att visas i ditt Temu-kreditsaldo inom 3 minuter och kan användas omedelbart. WARNING TO ALL USERS: Temu’s "Flash Sale" are a complete trap!
​I won a hand mixer through a official Temu promo game. When it arrived, it was completely DEAD ON ARRIVAL (DOA). I immediately recorded clear video proof showing the mixer plugged into a working socket and not turning on at all.
​When I reached out to Temu Support for a replacement, they:
​ACCUSED ME OF LYING and claimed it worked fine when shipped.
​REFUSED an exchange or replacement.
​Since I desperately needed the tool and Temu abandoned me, I took it to a repair technician. Diagnostic showed internal factory damage. The repair cost me nearly $200 out of my own pocket!
​NOW, after I threatened to take this to consumer rights agencies, Temu suddenly asks me to SHIP BACK MY ALREADY REPAIRED MIXER (which I just fixed with my own money!) with zero guarantee of a refund, offering a insulting $15 store credit instead!
​Temu uses "free gifts" to dump broken warehouse junk on users, refuses to take responsibility, and now wants to steal an item I spent $200 fixing! Absolutely unacceptable customer service and unfair commercial practices.
​Order ID: PO-208-12255113704310200
Fix this immediately and reimburse my losses!
data.review_headline: Scam Promo "Prizes": Sent broken mixer, lied about support, forced $200 repair!

data.review_body:
UPDATE: Following my review yesterday, I have been contacted by Temu, both on TP and by email. I’m delighted to confirm that Temu has credited my account with the full amount of £51.59. I appreciate the rethink and the refund so thank you to both Temu and TP. Because of this response, I’m changing my review to 4*, although it shouldn’t require a TP review to achieve a positive outcome. A lesson for us all…don’t give up or give in when you know that you’re right! I look forward to some happy hours of Temu browsing in the near future. 
Until last week, I’d have given Temu 5*, particularly for their customer service. I’ve spent a lot of money with them, frequently through browsing rather than specific shopping. Not any longer. I placed an order with Temu for £59.51, the seller was a UK ‘local’ company called UKBS. It turns out that I’ve been scammed. Instead of sending the 6kg consumables that I ordered and paid for, UKBS sent 1kg of the wrong product in a small box but with an invoice showing the correct order. The invoice itself actually shows more than one business name and contact details so they can’t even get that that right. I contacted Temu for a refund and they’ve refused, 3 times! Every email I receive from ‘Customer Service’ begins with ‘we know how you feel’ and ignores everything I say to them. Basically, Temu is allowing scam businesses to operate via their site and, rather than removing them, reporting them to the police, protecting their customers and their own reputation, they’re actually supporting rogue traders’ despicable behaviour. I’ve now raised a dispute with my bank, in the hope that they’ll help me recover my stolen money but I’m pretty much done with Temu now. I may buy the odd useful thing specifically but all browsing shopping will cease forthwith. Sad for Temu and me but clearly they don’t give a monkey’s. Obviously plenty more naive idiots like me lining up to be ripped off. My advice is, if you are ordering from a ‘local’ company via Temu, check TrustPilot first. If I’d checked the UKBS reviews, I wouldn’t have been scammed but I trusted Temu; more fool me.

data.review_body:
Absolutely terrible experience.

I used a £15 coupon on an item costing over £15, and the £15 was clearly deducted from that item at checkout, leaving only around £3 to pay. I then added four additional items to my order. At no point was it clearly shown that the coupon was being applied to these four items.

Two of those items arrived damaged/poor quality, including one that was chipped, so I requested a return.

That’s when the nightmare started. Customer Service kept telling me I could only receive a partial refund because the two items had supposedly been discounted by the coupon. But that is not what was shown when I placed the order — the coupon had already been clearly applied to the original item.

I repeatedly explained this, but the CS agent completely misunderstood my point and just kept repeating, “you will only get a partial refund because the items were purchased at a discounted price.”

This is not a problem with me “not understanding” the explanation. The problem is that they failed to understand the actual issue I was raising.

If the coupon was supposedly being allocated across multiple items, why was this not clearly displayed at checkout?

data.review_body:
Je suis très étonnée de ce que je lis, mais je ne mets rien en doute. Pour ce qui est de mes expériences personnelles, je n'ai eu aucun problème avec TEMU. Les produits correspondent à ce qui est annoncé, mais il est vrai que lorsqu'on commande un article à 2 euros, il faut s'attendre à en avoir pour 2 euros ! Quand des incidents ont pu survenir, ils ont toujours été intégralement et immédiatement pris en charge par TEMU. Nouvel envoi ... annulation ... remboursement, je n'ai jamais eu à me battre pour que l'incident se résolve toujours à mon entière satisfaction.

Maintenant, en effet, ça, c'était avant.

J'ai beau savoir que TEMU n'est pas responsable de l'évolution du traitement des commandes, je me trouve aussi impactée par :
- les délais de livraisons très, très, très allongés et
- les prix considérablement alourdis par les nouveaux frais d'import nouvellement imposés -même si TEMU en prend beaucoup à sa charge.

Personnellement, je déteste ces magouilles et autres politiques protectionnistes bien peu "fair" et bien faciles qui activent toujours le choix du moindre effort et qui s'exercent totalement au détriment de l'acheteur.
data.review_headline: Je suis très étonnée de ce que je lis

data.review_body:
I have made many purchases from TEMU over several years.
I purchased a 10 gallon Air Compressor March 2026. It is now August 2026 and the compressor has stopped working. There is a one year warranty. After contacting TEMU, who asked to send video of the problem. Which I promptly complied with, showing the compressor ran for a few seconds at a very low RPM then it would shut down. The circuit used was a 20amp dedicated circuit.They continued to state they would rectify this problem to my satisfaction. They shifted that burden to the manufacturer. After multiple suggestions from the manufacturer, on possible repairs to the compressor. None of which fixed the problem. Then TEMU  stated they would NOT, replace the compressor or refund the cost! I am now in the process of starting an investigation with my state Division of Consumer Affairs, and the Consumer Fraud Protection Agency! 

Update 8-26-2026
TEMU has agreed to refund the cost of the compressor to my original payment method. 
I appreciate their resolution to the issue. 
9-1-26
As stated in my previous update, TEMU has agreed to honor the warranty for the defective air compressor. I am currently awaiting the refund to my original payment method. 
I will update once the refund is credited to my account.

Bestellte Temu Ware nie erhalten. Temu-Lieferant J&T hat sogar bestätigt, dass mein Paket an eine fremde Person in der Nachbarschaft übergeben wurde. Trotzdem weigert sich Temu bis heute, den Vorgang vernünftig zu klären und Klarna entsprechend zu informieren.

Statt einer Lösung werde ich seit Wochen zwischen Temu, J&T und Klarna hin- und hergeschickt, während weiterhin Forderungen und zusätzliche Magn-Gebühren entstehen. Sämtliche Nachweise wurden mehrfach eingereicht.

Ich werde definitiv nicht für Ware bezahlen, die ich nie erhalten habe. Der Vorgang wird nun meinem Rechtsanwalt übergeben.

So einen Kundenservice und Umgang mit einer berechtigten Reklamation habe ich selten erlebt. Für mich war es das mit Temu.

Der Artikel an sich ist ganz okay. Allerdings muss man sich klar darüber sein das kein Akku dabei ist und man diesen extra kaufen muss!!!!! Somit kommen zu dem mit gut 22 Euro erworben Artikel noch um die ca 49 Euro für einen passenden Akku dazu!!!
Was allerdings noch viel schlimmer ist, und für diese schlechte Bewertung geführt hat, ist die Verdummung mit der Geschenke Werbung!!!! Man sucht sich die 5 Geschenke aus, bestellt dann einen Artikel für um die 22 Euro, und soll dann die 5 ausgewählten Artikel bei der Lieferung mit dazu geliefert bekommen!!!!
Soviel zur Theorie. Die Wirklichkeit sieht leider anders aus, denn geliefert wurde lediglich der bezahlte Artikel, nicht aber die ausgewählten 5 Geschenke!!!!
Somit befinden wir uns meiner Meinung nach, im Bereich von arglistiger Täuschung, wenn nicht gar Betrug!!!!!!
Für mich war das jetzt definitiv das letzte Mal, das ich bei Temu was gekauft habe!!!!!! Ich werde nun die App wieder löschen und diese ganz schnell aus meinem Gedächtnis streichen!!!!!
Soll heißen: NICHT ZU EMPFEHLEN !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

Just wasted a day getting nowhere with there alleged customer services, ordered a stainless sink, coming from uk so delivery was ok. Opened it immediately damage to 3 corners plus numerous scratches, reported straight away, seemed easy to do, they accepted the photos as proof of damage, but will only refund when item is returned, fair enough but that’s where it all went wrong! Can’t get a return label from the Temu supplier? When you contact them through Temu only online chat! Several times, only response is be patient! Then went onto Temu online chat (not a real person) after repeating myself many times I was supposed to be transferred to MIA (a real person) ? At one point she typed I will contact the company direct for you, this then changed to be more patient dispute my reminding them that my contract was with Temu and I would like them to refund me as agreed and instruct the supplier to pick up the damaged item, oh no that wasn’t going to happen, so we are back to be patient and wait. I’ve done being patient so Temu you have another bad review and friends and family will be advised of your lack of customer service and I shall have to go onto other methods to get my money back.
Obviously be warned, you buy at your peril 
Would like to have given them no stars

data.review_body:
If you ever have any problems with Temu, their customer service is overly obstructive and it's all through an online translator. 

#PO-210-17401281518713769‎

I placed an order which was delivered by Evri was left on my front doorstep, the delivery driver took a photo of it and from Temu's perspective they said it was delivered. I live on a busy road, the item was stolen. I made a police report, got a crime reference number. Temu denied me a request for a replacement, and/or refund. I've written to their head office WhaleCo UK Ltd, E14 5HU, but again ignored. Happily going to waste my money initiating proceedings in the small claims court so other people can know what a sham of a company it is.

Edit: I complained directly to Temu Customer Services on the app 6 times and got called a liar each time, there's no option to escalate your complaint, it's designed to be obstructive to anyone making a complaint. I got my money back, not from them, but by doing a chargeback on my credit card. Evri are known for poor deliveries in the UK as their drivers get paid regardless of whether the packages actually get received. Ultimately that could have been resolved easily had Temu had a reasonable complaints system.
data.review_headline: Item delivered left on doorstep on busy street, then stolen, Temu "it's not my problem as we have a photo of proof"

Warning, Scam! Temu covers fraudulent sellers and blocks victimized buyers!

My child accidentally ordered a phone. We kept the package completely unopened, agreed on the return with the seller, and sent it back exactly as it arrived. Afterward, the seller shamelessly sent a photo of an allegedly empty box and refused the refund. This is an absolute lie and a total ripoff!
Instead of helping, Temu simply blocked my account. This is how the platform destroys evidence, protects scammers, and treats scammed buyers like liars! Even PayPal buyer protection failed because Temu and the seller got away with fake photos.
I was scammed, robbed, and then blocked so I couldn't fight back. Do not buy here! If anything goes wrong, Temu will steal your money and ban your profile!

Achtung, Betrug! Temu deckt betrügerische Verkäufer und sperrt Kunden!

Mein Kind hat versehentlich ein Handy bestellt. Wir haben das Paket ungeöffnet gelassen, den Rückversand mit dem Verkäufer abgesprochen und es ungeöffnet zurückgeschickt. Der Verkäufer hat danach frech ein Foto eines angeblich leeren Kartons geschickt und die Rückzahlung verweigert. Eine absolute Lüge und Abzocke!
Anstatt zu helfen, hat Temu mein Konto einfach komplett gesperrt. So vernichtet die Plattform Beweise, schützt betrügerische Händler und stellt die geprellten Käufer als Lügner dar! Sogar der PayPal-Käuferschutz hat versagt, weil Temu und der Verkäufer mit gefälschten Fotos durchkommen.
Man hat mich hier betrogen, bestohlen und am Ende noch blockiert, damit ich mich nicht wehren kann. Kaufen Sie hier auf keinen Fall! Wenn etwas schiefgeht, klaut Temu Ihr Geld und sperrt Ihr Profil!

Total scam and terrible customer service! Temu approved a return for 2 items past their deadline and sent me return codes. I shipped the items back, and they received them. After that, they stopped replying. Their chat support is useless; I have to explain everything from scratch every single time. To make things worse, they refunded me for a completely different, 3-times cheaper order that I never complained about! They stole my items and my money. Avoid at all costs!"Extremely disappointed and feeling deceived by Temu

I have been in conflict with Temu for more than a month and a half regarding defective products. On August 7, I finally managed to return the disputed items from two orders:

PO-026-10465195735672615 – wallpaper that started peeling off the wall after some time.

PO-026-20115488410232615 – a window-cleaning robot that stopped working properly only a few months after purchase.

After a long period of trying to resolve these issues, Temu refunded only part of the money. After I posted my review on their public page, they contacted me, promising that they would resolve the problem. Unfortunately, nothing has actually been resolved.

I am deeply disappointed. More than the money, I feel deceived, humiliated and completely disregarded as a customer. I have never experienced so much frustration and inconsistency when trying to resolve a legitimate complaint.

I want to warn other Temu customers to be very careful. In my experience, when a hidden or delayed defect appears after the 90-day period, it becomes extremely difficult to obtain a fair solution. In my case, I was essentially left with the impression that once the 90 days had passed, the responsibility was no longer theirs—even though the products developed problems only after a few months.

I believe customers should know about this before spending their money. Keep all receipts, photos, videos and communication with Temu, especially when buying products that may develop defects over time.

This experience has completely destroyed my trust in Temu. I feel deeply disappointed and let down by the way my case has been handled.

Be careful and know your consumer rights before buying from Temu.

data.review_body:
Heute meine letzte Bestellung bei Temu aufgegeben. 

Grundsätzlich hatte ich zunehmend das Gefühl, dass die Qualität sinkt, während die Preise soweit gestiegen sind, dass man eigentlich auch sinnvoller vor Ort kaufen könnte. Die letzten Checkouts waren auch schwierig, da obwohl der Warenkorb mit unter 150€ angezeigt wurde, Temu trotzdem Zoll aufgeschlagen hat und man Waren wieder entfernen musste, um auf unter ca. 130€ im Warenkorb zu kommen, damit das ohne Einfuhrzoll durchgeht, weiß nicht, was da bei denen nicht rund lief.
Aber es war halt praktisch für die Verkleidungskiste der Kleinen, weil Kostüme und Schmuck halt doch günstiger waren, deshalb hat man's noch ab und an gemacht. 

Nun wurde ja zum 1. Juli die Zollfreiheit unter 150€ aufgehoben. Stattdessen wird bei Einfuhr unter 150€ pro WARENKATEGORIE pauschal 3€ Zoll erhoben. Eigentlich kein Problem, außer für Temu, denen das scheinbar zu viel Arbeit ist, nach Kategorien zu verzollen und die das dadurch umgehen, dass sie JEDEN POSTEN der Bestellung mit 3€ mit dem Zoll verrechnen (der freut sich natürlich, wer stört sich schon an zu viel Einnahmen).
Bestelle ich 2 gleiche Kleider/Hosen/tralala, sind das nur 3€, weil nur 1 Posten, bestelle ich 10 verschiedene Kleider/Hosen/tralala, sind das laut Zollverordnung auch nur 3€, Temu verrechnet aber 30€.

Kurze Frage, Temu: wenn Sie 40% (und max. 20€) unnötiger Steuern anteilig übernehmen, wie viel zahle ich als Kunde dann trotzdem noch drauf, obwohl ich es nicht müsste?

Hier wird tatsächlich mitunter Zoll abgeführt, der nicht abgeführt werden muss, und somit sollte sich jeder Kunde auch darüber im Klaren sein, dass jeder Artikel ihn 3€ mehr kostet, als im Shop dran steht.
Damit sind zum Beispiel alle kleinpreisigen Artikel direkt raus, da diese dann eben nicht mehr kleinpreisig sind.


Was mich tatsächlich noch mehr ärgert ist, dass man das nicht klar kommuniziert. Wer sich da nicht selbst ins Thema einliest, denkt, das gehöre so und Temu wäre auch noch so großzügig, sich an den Zollgebühren zu beteiligen. 

Tut es nicht. Jede Sendung wird nach Kategorie verzollt, bestellt jemand also ausschließlich Hosen, fallen dafür rein rechtlich nur 3€ Zoll an, egal wie viele Teile, sofern der Gesamtpreis 150€ nicht übersteigt. 
Aber das macht halt mehr Arbeit, als einfach die Anzahl der Posten einer Bestellung herzunehmen und der Kunde darf diese Arbeitsersparnis finanzieren.

Danke, nein, war für mich das letzte Mal und auch nur, weil mir das erst beim versuchten Abschluss aufgefallen ist und ich nicht die Zeit habe, das noch groß woanders aufzutun, bevor es gebraucht wird. Ich zahle das jetzt einmalig für MEINE Arbeitsersparnis und habe den Warenkorb vorher aufs absolut Nötigste reduziert.


Zur Antwort des Anbieters:
Ja, es fallen Zollgebühren an, aber nicht in der von Ihnen berechneten Höhe.
Sie berechnen 3€ pro Artikel, die Zollverordnung verlangt 3€ pro Warenkategorie. Es sollte preislich keinen Unterschied machen, ob ich zwei verschiedene oder zwei gleiche Badeanzüge bestelle.
Das sind am Ende der Bestellung teils zwei völlig verschiedene Summen.

Ja, es ist ersichtlich, in welcher Höhe Gebühren bei der Bestellung entstehen.
Es ist hingegen NICHT ersichtlich, dass die Gebühren, die entstehen, nur zu einem Teil der Zollverordnung geschuldet sind und zum anderen Teil dem, dass Sie nicht korrekt nach Kategorien verzollen.

So zahlt der Kunde einmal aufgrund der neuen Importzölle mehr, und einmal noch oben drauf, weil nicht darauf geachtet wird, dass man da möglichst sparsam verzollt. Ihnen wird auch klar sein, dass sich das bei bestimmten Artikeln dann schlicht nicht mehr rechnet.

Darauf mache ich andere Kunden aufmerksam, dafür ist diese Website da.
data.review_headline: Völlig aberwitzige Zollgebühren, die NICHT der Zollverordnung entsprechen

data.review_body:
Over several years I have been a regular customer of TEMU, spent quite a lot of money, and learned through trial and error what to purchase, and what to stay away from. Mostly I financially absorbed wrongful/shoddy inexpensive items, and did not return, unless big ticket items. I always left positive reviews - never negative ones.

For example, sizing inconsistencies is a BIG issue, and the main reason for returns, which generally were hassle free once you figured the system and uploaded photos to obtain a return label.  Rarely, if at all, there were no reasons to return, up until recently.  A certain brand of pleated dresses were a big favorite of mine; I had the size down pat, and bought many (10 by last count) and been very happy. However, the last purchase was way off - really off in sizing, and I received a child size of a five year old instead. 

Same day of receiving it, I uploaded the photo to TEMU and got a return shipping label immediately. Dress was a mere $12. In the same package, was two long flower boxes. One was badly wrapped in thin cellophane, and the other unwrapped. Sizing was inconsisent with the description, and as there were two of them for $24 they were returned also. Uploaded photos, and received a return shipping label.

Received confirmation return items were received in NJ, but because the cellophane was not on one of the boxes (same condition as received) but obviously identical to the other one which came as a set, TEMU refused to refund.  Same with the dress. BUT, they kept the items!!  

I wrote a detailed polite grievance for reconsideration, (highly doubt any are ever read) and received a flat NO. 
Really surprised considering I have been a regular customer, always given positive reviews, yet the attitude was horrific.  

I contacted AE and opened a dispute who got my refund.  However, due to my opening a dispute, TEMU blocks you permanently for ever purchasing from them again. Timeline was May/June 2026.

Oh well, for a small amount of money, TEMU lost not only a customer, but also a referal source as well.  Many of my friends often complimented me on the dresses I have purchased over the years, and after I relate my negative experience, none chose to become a customer.

None of this was necessary, and certainly not a professional customer service attitude.

Update: 8/24/26  After TEMU left a response to my complaint to contact them, I did just that. Sorry to say, their response of how much they value customer satisfaction etc is AI robotic nonsense and is not authentic.  Just words to look good after a negative review to absolve themselves from negativity and look as if they value customer service.  I Just spent an hour to unblock my account with a fresh order which was blocked due as referenced to my complaint review written above. First I got a BOT who rattles off the same robotic sentences about valuing you as a customer. Then a live person named St...y Lewis came onto the CHAT and I explained the situation. She was apologetic with the word salad, and would resolve it. However, she disappeared and another person named Rana took over. I re-explained that I was in the midst of placing an order but TEMU blocked me because I had previously disputed a $12 returned item they KEPT but refused to refund me which got resolved when AE interceded on my behalf. After stating she would resolve it, reiterated as I stated above. Blocked. Retaliation for disputing a refund.
TEMU deserves the negative reviews.  A serious company, would take responsibility and resolve issues in good faith with honest behavior.

1 star – Temu won't tell me which day I supposedly missed

I took part in Temu's ClaimCredit promotion offering £30.50 in credit.

I returned and claimed the rewards as they became available. I have screenshots showing rewards 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 as claimed. Reward 6 (£2.44) specifically showed “Valid on Aug 23”, and I returned on 23 August and successfully claimed that too.

Despite this, Temu marked the final £21.37 reward as expired, saying I had missed a day during the 7-day claim period.

I contacted customer service and asked a very simple question: which exact day did I miss?

I have now asked this repeatedly and even had the case escalated. Instead of providing the date, Temu keeps sending me general explanations of how the 7-day promotion works.

I understand the rules. What I want to know is which date Temu's records show I failed to claim, because my screenshots show all six numbered rewards that became available were claimed.

Temu offered me £8 compensation, but I declined because I would rather have the £21.37 credit I believe I legitimately earned.

If Temu responds to this review, I would simply like them to answer the question their customer service team has repeatedly avoided:

What exact date did I supposedly miss, and what was the claim deadline on that date?

I have screenshots of my claim history and the customer-service correspondence to support everything stated above.

Update edit 01-09-26. Temu customer service gave me the run around. Just kept repeating them selves . It's like they are responding from a sheet. Dont think they even looked at my evidence. Got about 8 responses from them saying the same thing. Offered me coupons that I have to buy other things to get, no thanks . Offered me 12 quid, then subsequently offered 8 instead 3 times.i refused every time . My last response I have informed them they have lost a customer as I feel scammed and that I would inform others on every review site I know.

Jag beställde en soffa från Temu för cirka 5 400 kr. När soffan kom var den både skadad och motsvarade inte bilderna eller beskrivningen på hemsidan. Jag har bilder och dokumentation som bevis på detta.

Jag kontaktade Temu direkt för att returnera soffan. Jag fick först en returetikett som var så suddig att den inte gick att läsa eller skanna. Jag kontaktade dem igen och fick en ny, men även den var oanvändbar. Sedan dess har jag under cirka två till tre månader kontaktat Temu upprepade gånger för att få en fungerande returetikett. Trots detta har problemet fortfarande inte lösts.

Nu vill Temu att jag själv ska ordna och betala returfrakten till Tyskland. Det handlar om en stor och tung soffa, så kostnaden kan bli mycket hög. Jag tycker inte att det är rimligt att jag ska betala för detta när varan kom skadad, inte motsvarade beskrivningen och jag dessutom försökte returnera den inom returperioden.

Det som gör situationen ännu mer frustrerande är att Temu nu vill erbjuda återbetalning i Temu-kredit. Jag vill inte ha kredit – jag vill få tillbaka mina pengar på den ursprungliga betalningsmetoden.

Jag har försökt lösa detta på ett lugnt sätt under flera månader och även varit i kontakt med Klarna. Jag har skickat bilder, förklarat situationen flera gånger och följt deras instruktioner. Ändå står jag fortfarande med en trasig soffa och utan en fungerande returlösning.

Jag hoppas att Temu tar detta på allvar och ger mig en kostnadsfri retur/upphämtning samt återbetalar hela beloppet till min ursprungliga betalningsmetod. Jag vill bara få tillbaka mina pengar för en vara som jag inte har fått i det skick eller den kvalitet som utlovades.
data.review_headline: Jag beställde en soffa från Temu för…

data.review_body:
TOTAL SCAM! False description, fake UK warehouse, and Temu censors negative reviews!

I ordered an 80-piece marker set from a seller named "DailyMora" on Temu. The listing was explicitly advertised as a professional "Acrylic Marker Pen Set" featuring a soft "Brush Tip (1-6mm)" on one end and a super-fine "0.4mm Fine Tip" on the other. The seller also heavily advertised a "UK Local Warehouse" with a British flag, promising 1-business-day fastest delivery. Every single one of these claims turned out to be an absolute lie.
Here is the reality of what happened:

 - Fake Ink Type: The pens are NOT acrylic paint markers at all. They are cheap, ordinary, transparent alcohol-based markers. Because it is alcohol ink, it completely bleeds through materials, cannot be layered (the top color dissolves the bottom layer), and is entirely useless for my intended purpose (rock painting). To make matters worse, when a clear sealant/varnish spray is applied to fix the drawing, the alcohol ink reactivates and the lines blur, bleed, and turn into a messy brown smudge.

-Wrong Physical Pen Tips: There is no soft brush tip and absolutely no 0.4mm fine tip. Instead, the markers have a rigid, wide chisel/broad tip on one end and a standard medium bullet tip on the other. The barrel of the pen literally has "Broad" printed on it, completely contradicting the listing.

- Fake UK Warehouse: Despite the seller using a British flag and a registered paper-only address in Manchester to look legitimate, the product did NOT ship from the UK. It was shipped directly from China, taking days to arrive. On top of that, checking the safety section reveals that the seller completely hid the mandatory manufacturer information and product identification.

- Censorship & Protection of Scammers: When I tried to warn other buyers by leaving an honest, fact-based 1-star review with clear photographic evidence, I discovered that the seller had completely disabled the review section on the product page. Temu actively protects these fraudulent sellers by allowing them to censor negative feedback, delete listings, and re-upload them as "brand new" to wipe away their bad reputation.

Fortunately, I opened a dispute with Klarna, provided my concrete photographic proof (the chisel tip, the bleeding stone test, and the Evri tracking receipt H055BA0045889587), and Klarna immediately paused my payments. The package has already been dropped off and is on its way back to Temu's fulfillment center.
Do not trust this seller, do not trust "Acrylic" listings with black marker barrels on Temu, and be aware that the platform actively hides the truth from you to keep sales moving. Total scam!

data.review_body:
I am beyond frustrated with Temu and want other customers to know how my return has been handled. I returned ALL 10 dresses from one order in ONE package using Temu’s return process. Temu refunded only 5 and claims its warehouse found only 5, leaving me fighting for the remaining $44.97.
I have a UPS drop off receipt for the exact disputed tracking number showing that the package I handed to UPS weighed approximately 3 lb 9.2 oz. I returned the entire order because ALL 10 dresses were poor quality, thin and see through. I had absolutely NO reason to keep five of them, and I do not have them.
Instead of simply making this right for a repeat customer, Temu has dragged this out for weeks, involved multiple customer service representatives and supervisors, discussed warehouse inspection videos and processing records, asked me whether I happened to take PHOTOS OR VIDEOS of myself packing an ordinary return, and even brought an entirely separate order into the discussion. Who routinely films themselves packing a retail return because they expect the retailer to later claim half the merchandise disappeared?
I have repeatedly purchased from Temu and have never tried to take advantage of their refund policy. I have now had to provide documentation, open a PayPal dispute, file a BBB complaint, and spend an absurd amount of my own time fighting for $44.97 for merchandise I RETURNED.
This is absolutely ridiculous customer service. Temu is willing to destroy the trust of a repeat customer over $44.97 rather than take responsibility for the possibility that something happened during shipping, return processing, or warehouse handling.
If Temu does not make this right, I will NEVER purchase from this company again. I strongly encourage anyone shopping with Temu to keep every shipping receipt and document your returns carefully, because my experience has shown me just how difficult it can be to get your money back when Temu claims returned merchandise is missing.

data.review_body:
I have been waiting 3 weeks for my money from Temu’s affiliate program.

I completed all the requirements: I referred people who made qualifying purchases, waited the required 30 days for the commissions to become available, and then redeemed my money for withdrawal. Temu told me that the payment would appear in my bank account within approximately 48 hours, but it has now been 3 weeks and I still have not received my money.

I have contacted customer support several times, and every time I get a different explanation. First, I was told that my payment was under investigation. Then I was told that they were having system issues. Now I am being told that it is still under verification.

What is frustrating is that nobody gives me a clear solution or a specific date for when I will receive my money. Who else do I need to contact to get Temu to pay the money I am owed?

I fulfilled my part and followed all the requirements. It is unacceptable to wait weeks for a payment that was supposed to take only 48 hours. I hope Temu resolves this issue and releases my payment as soon as possible.

I ordered some trays for an air fryer and they were absolute rubbish. I gave a review stating that they were not fit for purpose. They gave me a credit on the basis I return. I stated that they can keep their credit because with all the hoops to jump through and the distance in the round trip that they can keep the credit and I will bin the rubbish. They removed the credit. I thought that was the end of the matter.

The 30 day period for returning had passed and low and behold they charged the amount to my credit. I have been involved in continuous correspondence and getting nowhere. I have given numerous chances and tried in simple terms to explain but either they are stupid or they don't want to refund my money and that is theft.

 I get offers to my Temu account if I spend in excess of an amount. I don't want anything else from this lot except a refund to my credit card.

I am now about to open a dispute with the cr3dit card company.

The only advice I can give anyone is that what you see in the photo may not be what you will get. The only communication and methods of returning is full of hurdles and the purchaser has to do all the donkey work. The emails you get often don't really address your problems.

data.review_body: È da un mese che subisco un trattamento inaccettabile e una deliberata strategia di sfinimento psicologico da parte dell'assistenza Temu per l'ordine definitivo PO-098-15780589855352293 del 16 agosto 2026 . Il loro software ERP ha un gravissimo BUG di calcolo fiscale che applica dazi IOSS fissi multipli e illegittimi (triplicando la tariffa) su merci nello stesso pacco che appartengono allo STESSO codice TARIC UE  .Il sistema va in totale confusione a causa delle descrizioni testuali fantasiose inserite dai singoli venditori sulla piattaforma, oppure perché gli stessi applicano codici TARIC errati a propria interpretazione. Questo genera dazi illegittimi e un overcharging sistematico a danno dei consumatori europei.Per dimostrare l'errore ed escludere ogni dubbio, ho effettuato ben 5 simulazioni d'ordine differenti (poi annullate), creando schemi precisi per fornire all'assistenza prove pratiche e incontestabili del Bug prima di procedere all'acquisto effettivo. Ho persino fornito a Temu la tabella doganale TARIC completa in cinese e uno schema millimetrico dell'ordine. Tutto inutile.Ho le prove storiche del malfunzionamento: a fine LUGLIO ho dimostrato all'operatore Zany lo stesso bug nella categoria "Cappelli in poliestere". Dopo aver fornito le tabelle, i tecnici hanno segretamente corretto l'algoritmo (risolvendo il problema dei cappelli). Il 1° agosto ho avvisato che avrei controllato il comparto "Bigiotteria" e puntualmente il Bug si è ripresentato.Per questo ordine definitivo, gli operatori James ed Elisabetta oggi, 20 agosto, mi inviano a raffica la stessa identica mail copia-incolla risalente all'8 e al 4 agosto sul "dovere di riscuotere l'IVA"  . Siete incompetenti! Io NON contesto l'IVA, contesto la moltiplicazione della tariffa fissa di sdoganamento IOSS generata dal vostro software, che per la legge UE (Regolamento UE e linee guida H7) si applica UNA SOLA VOLTA PER PACCO UNICO e non per quanti lotti inventa il vostro sistema  .Di seguito riporto lo schema tecnico analitico della frode tariffaria generata dal vostro sistema (il pacco è UNO SOLO e tutti i 34 articoli appartengono alla stessa identica classificazione doganale TARIC 7117.19.00.90 - Bigiotteria in metallo comune) [INDEX]:LOTTO 1 (22 articoli): Bracciali, anelli e orecchini (es. Set Stella Marina, Ganci Argento, Bracciale Baciamano, Anello Nero). -> Applicati erroneamente 3,66€ [INDEX].LOTTO 2 (11 articoli): Gioielli stile vintage e perle artificiali (es. Bracciale Pianeta, anelli simil perla). -> Applicati erroneamente ulteriori 3,66€  .LOTTO 3 (1 articolo): 1 bracciale in metallo con turchese artificiale isolato dal sistema. -> Applicati erroneamente ulteriori 3,66€  .Danno economico visibile a carrello: 10,98€ di "Oneri all'importazione" addebitati invece di 3,66€ per un unico pacco (Trattenuti ingiustamente 7,32€)  Aggiornamento  Prendo atto della vostra risposta standard qui sopra, ma vi invito a interrompere i messaggi preconfezionati sulla "pazienza e comprensione" . Il vostro dipartimento competente ha già in mano il ticket di follow-up accelerato n. 1786955056098351 e l'intero dossier bilingue inviato via e-mail al supervisore Kaius  . I dati matematici sono incontestabili: 34 articoli unificati in un solo pacco sotto lo stesso identico codice TARIC 7117.19.00.90 (bigiotteria) . Il vostro software ERP ha applicato tre volte la tariffa fissa IOSS (10,98€ invece di 3,66€), prelevando illecitamente 7,32€ dal mio saldo privato Temu. Non serve tempo per investigare, serve solo che un manager prema il tasto "rimborso manuale" della differenza e che i vostri programmatori correggano l'algoritmo, esattamente come hanno già fatto a fine luglio per la categoria dei cappelli in poliestere dopo la mia prima segnalazione all'operatore Zany  . Questa recensione rimarrà a 1 stella ed estesa formalmente agli organi di controllo europei (ECC Net e Agenzia delle Dogane) finché i 7,32€ non saranno riaccreditati sul mio account  . Risolvete i bug del vostro software invece di fare pubbliche relazioni e leggere ciò che un cliente scrive ,invece di rispondere con risposte preinpostate copia ed incolla che non hanno nulla a che vedere con il problema segnalando.Un essere un mano può risolvere quello che una macchina non può a causa algoritmica!
