data.review_body:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Temu.

I ordered a personalised photo product, but when it arrived the quality was very poor and not what I expected at all. The image quality on the finished product was disappointing, and I contacted Temu to ask for a refund.

What upset me even more was the way the refund was handled. Temu told me that I would have to return the personalised item containing my photograph in order to receive my money back. I explained clearly that I was not comfortable sending a personal photograph back through the post. For privacy reasons, I do not believe I should be pressured into returning an item containing such a personal image simply because the product they supplied was of poor quality.

I uploaded photographs showing the item and the poor quality, so Temu could clearly see the problem. Despite this evidence, they still refused to give me a proper refund.

Instead, I was offered a £20 credit which could only be used on another Temu order above £20. I did not ask for store credit — I asked for my money back for a product that I was unhappy with. Offering credit that requires me to spend money with Temu again is not, in my opinion, a satisfactory resolution.

I continued to explain that I wanted a monetary refund and that I was uncomfortable returning my personal photograph, but Temu would not resolve the matter.

This experience has completely changed my opinion of Temu. Customer service should be about listening to genuine concerns and finding a reasonable solution, especially where personalised family photographs and privacy are involved.

I have been left with a poor-quality product, no proper refund, and an offer of credit that I do not want.

Very poor customer service and a very disappointing experience.
data.review_headline: Very disappointed – poor quality and unacceptable refund process

I contacted Temu on 26 July 2026 because I needed an item by 15 August. Before placing my order, I contacted Customer Service for important information about a product. I was told to wait while they checked with the manufacturer. I waited for a few days as instructed, only for Temu to close the ticket without resolving my question, without providing the information I was waiting for, and without even properly informing me of what had happened.

This directly delayed my purchase. Had Temu responded when I first contacted them, I could have placed my order earlier and avoided this entire situation.

After placing my order, I made it VERY clear that I needed the items by 15 August. I also asked Temu to ship the available items separately from the pre-order item so that the items I urgently needed would not be held back. Again, nothing useful was done.

Since then, I have been the one constantly proposing solutions. I suggested separate shipment, compensation for the additional cost of alternatives, 50% credit compensation, and other practical ways to resolve the situation. Instead of actually working with me on one of these solutions, Customer Service repeatedly gave me generic copy-and-paste responses telling me to wait, return the order, refuse delivery, or accept small amounts of credit.

I was repeatedly told that my case had been escalated to a supervisor/manager, that it was being reviewed, and that someone would get back to me. Days passed. No manager. No supervisor. No meaningful escalation. Just more Customer Service replies and the same generic answers.

Because of Temu’s handling of this situation, I was forced to look for alternative items at my own expense, despite contacting Temu in advance specifically to avoid this situation. I asked Temu to provide reasonable compensation because I was being financially disadvantaged by the way my case was handled. They refused. Their solution? Rs 90 credit, followed by another 5 credits worth Rs 271. What am I supposed to do with Rs 271 when I am being forced to spend significantly more money on alternatives?

They repeatedly told me to wait, then told me to return the order, refuse delivery, or wait until it arrived. None of these solutions addressed the actual problem: I needed the items by a specific date, and Temu failed to provide a practical solution despite me repeatedly giving them solutions myself.

Even after receiving the order, the return process became another problem. I was told that door-to-door collection was unavailable in my area and that I would have to take the parcel to a return location myself, while the courier’s official website states that pickup services are available.

The worst part is the complete lack of accountability. I kept providing them with solutions; they did nothing with them. Instead, I received generic responses over and over again.

This has been an extremely frustrating and unacceptable customer service experience. If something goes wrong with your order, don’t expect Temu Customer Service to actually take ownership of the problem. You may end up spending days chasing agents, repeating yourself, being told your case has been escalated, and ultimately having to solve the problem yourself and pay out of pocket.

Update after your reply - This response is exactly the problem I described in my review: another generic response directing me back to Customer Service. I have already spent weeks contacting your Customer Service team, repeatedly explaining the same issue and proposing practical solutions. I was repeatedly told my case had been escalated to a supervisor/manager, yet I continued receiving generic responses without a meaningful resolution.

I have already exhausted your Customer Service process. Telling me to contact the same channel again does not address my complaint. If customer satisfaction is genuinely your priority, I expect someone from a senior team to actually review the full history of my case rather than sending another standard response.
data.review_headline: Absolutely unacceptable customer service, no accountability, no proper escalation, and no meaningful solution

Meine Erfahrung mit Temu und diesem Kauf ist schlicht katastrophal.

Der bestellte Rollwagen wurde zwar schnell geliefert, die Qualität war jedoch derart schlecht, dass ich ihn zurücksenden wollte. Und ab diesem Punkt begann das eigentliche Problem.

Die Rücksendung musste ich zunächst selbst bezahlen. Das Paket wurde ordnungsgemäß mit DHL an die auf dem Rücksendeetikett angegebene Adresse geschickt. Ich habe einen Einlieferungsbeleg, die Sendungsnummer, das Versandlabel und Fotos des Pakets. Laut DHL-Sendungsverfolgung wurde die Rücksendung erfolgreich zugestellt.

Trotzdem: keine Erstattung des Kaufpreises und keine Erstattung meiner Rücksendekosten.

Seit dem 30.07. läuft dazu ein Support-Ticket. Dem Kundenservice habe ich die entsprechenden Nachweise mehrfach geschickt. Statt einer Lösung bekomme ich seit Wochen immer wieder nahezu dieselben Standardantworten: Der Fall werde „geprüft“, eine „zuständige Abteilung“ sei eingeschaltet oder das Lager habe den Eingang angeblich noch nicht bestätigt.

Besonders absurd wurde es, als ich trotz des vorgelegten DHL-Zustellnachweises erneut aufgefordert wurde, mich an den Transportdienstleister zu wenden und einen Zustellnachweis zu besorgen. Genau diesen Nachweis hatte ich längst eingereicht.

Ich habe also Ware zurückgeschickt, den Rückversand zunächst selbst bezahlt, kann die Zustellung dokumentieren und muss anschließend wochenlang meinem Geld hinterherlaufen.

Wer hier bestellt, sollte sich meiner Erfahrung nach sehr genau überlegen, was passiert, wenn mit der Ware etwas nicht stimmt und eine Rücksendung notwendig wird. Eine schnelle Lieferung nützt wenig, wenn eine belegbar zugestellte Rücksendung anschließend zu einem wochenlangen Kampf um die Rückerstattung wird.

Für mich war das die letzte Bestellung bei Temu. 1 Stern ist für diese Erfahrung noch großzügig.

Very disappointing return and refund experience

I am extremely disappointed with Temu’s handling of my return and refund.

I returned the items in my parcel and had proof of postage, tracking information and a video of the parcel when I sent it. Despite this, Temu refused to refund me for two items, claiming they were not in the parcel.

What made the situation even more frustrating was that I received contradictory explanations from Temu. At one point, I was told that their return specialists had reviewed warehouse footage and concluded that the items were missing. Later, I was told that the parcel had not even been received or inspected at the warehouse and was asked to verify the shipping information.

My case was escalated to a supervisor and a senior customer resolution specialist, but after several days of waiting, Temu closed the review without giving me the refund.

I cooperated throughout the entire process and provided the evidence I had. I expected Temu to properly investigate the return and reach a fair resolution, but unfortunately that did not happen.

Based on my experience, I would advise customers to keep all proof of postage, tracking information, photographs/videos and screenshots of every conversation when returning items to Temu.

Update / Reply to Temu:

Thank you for your response. I appreciate that you have escalated my issue to the relevant team.

However, I have not been given a case or escalation reference number. Please provide me with the reference number so I can keep track of the investigation and refer to it when contacting customer service.

I am still waiting for the outstanding refund. I also hope the relevant team will review the evidence I provided, including my proof of postage, tracking information and video of the parcel, as well as the contradictory information I previously received regarding whether my return had been received and inspected.

I will update this review once the matter has been fully resolved and my refund has been received.

I have made around 130 orders on Temu and have been a regular customer.
​For a long time, my account received significantly lower prices than other accounts — often around 20–30% lower. The discount was clearly shown on my orders as “Temu's Specific Discount”. I have screenshots and order receipts confirming this.
​Recently, I received a damaged item and opened a dispute through Temu’s normal procedure. The refund was approved and I received my money back.
​What happened next is what concerns me.
​I placed one more order after the dispute, and the “Temu's Specific Discount” was completely gone. The prices on my account were now essentially the same as on other accounts. I have screenshots showing the prices before and after.
​I have not placed any further orders since then.
​The most frustrating part is that Temu never informed me that my account-specific discount had been removed or explained why. I contacted customer support several times (Ticket #1785676397096187) and asked a very specific question: why was this discount removed after an approved dispute?
​Instead of answering the question, I received generic and unrelated responses. I still have no clear explanation.
​I am not complaining about the refund — the refund was correctly approved for a damaged item. My concern is the unexplained change to my account after the dispute.
​After approximately 130 orders, I would expect a clear explanation rather than silently removing an account benefit and refusing to explain what happened.
​Temu, please explain: was my “Temu's Specific Discount” removed because I opened an approved dispute? If not, what exactly caused it to disappear immediately afterwards?

I have screenshots and order receipts confirming this.

Update: Temu responded to this review, but their response did not answer my specific question about why my “Temu's Specific Discount” disappeared. They simply directed me back to live chat, which I had already contacted several times without receiving a clear explanation.
data.review_headline: My Temu Specific Discount disappeared after an approved dispute

data.review_body:
Title: Deceptive Commercial Practices and Opaque Pricing

Rating: ★☆☆☆☆

It is with considerable disappointment that I must report my experience with Temu, a platform whose commercial conduct raises serious concerns regarding transparency and consumer protection. The pricing structure is fundamentally misleading: items are initially displayed exclusive of VAT and other import charges, which only materialise at the final stage of checkout. This deliberate omission prevents consumers from making informed purchasing decisions and artificially inflates the apparent affordability of goods.

Furthermore, the promotional mechanisms employed by Temu—purportedly generous coupons, “free” items, and substantial discounts—are encumbered by onerous and disproportionate conditions. Customers are required to spend exorbitant sums within exceptionally short timeframes to unlock benefits that are advertised as readily accessible. Such practices are not merely inconvenient; they are, by any reasonable standard, deceptive.

Equally troubling is the customer service response. Inquiries are met with repetitive, generic templates that fail to address substantive concerns. At no point has the company demonstrated accountability or a genuine willingness to resolve legitimate complaints.

I strongly caution consumers against engaging with this platform. The disparity between advertised value and actual cost, combined with unresponsive support and misleading promotional tactics, renders Temu an untrustworthy retailer. One star is, in my view, excessively generous.
data.review_headline: Deceptive Commercial Practices and Opaque Pricing

data.review_body:
Warnung vor Temu – sehr schlechter Kundenservice

Ich bin von Temu extrem enttäuscht und kann Temu nach diesem Vorfall nicht empfehlen.

Meine letzte tatsächliche Bestellung war am 18. Februar 2026. Trotzdem erhalte ich seit Monaten Mahnungen wegen angeblicher Bestellungen aus März und April, die ich niemals aufgegeben habe.
Auch unter meiner Bestellung steht letzter Bestellung am 18.02.2026

Ich habe den Kundenservice mehrfach kontaktiert und die Situation eindeutig erklärt. Statt den Fall vernünftig zu prüfen, bekomme ich immer wieder praktisch dieselbe Standardantwort: Die Bestellungen seien über mein Konto und ein „erkanntes Gerät“ aufgegeben worden. Das ist für mich kein ausreichender Nachweis.

Noch schlimmer: Ich bekomme trotz mehrfacher Nachfrage keine konkreten Bestellnachweise, keine Sendungsnummern und keinen Zustellnachweis für diese angeblichen Bestellungen. Wenn Temu tatsächlich behauptet, dass diese Bestellungen von mir stammen, warum kann Temu dann nicht einfach nachweisen, was bestellt wurde, wohin es geliefert wurde und wo die Sendungsnummer ist?

Ich fühle mich vom Kundenservice überhaupt nicht ernst genommen. Statt einer konkreten Lösung bekomme ich immer wieder dieselbe Antwort und gleichzeitig gehen die Mahnungen weiter.
Geht um 135,18 Euro!

Für mich ist das ein völlig unakzeptabler Umgang mit einem Kunden. Ein guter Kundenservice sollte einen solchen Fall untersuchen und konkrete Beweise liefern, anstatt den Kunden mit Standardantworten abzufertigen.

Nach dieser Erfahrung habe ich jegliches Vertrauen in Temu verloren. Ich rate anderen Kunden, ihre Bestellungen und Zahlungen sehr genau zu kontrollieren und bei Problemen nicht lockerzulassen.

Sehr schlechter Kundenservice – keine Lösung, keine konkreten Nachweise, immer nur dieselbe Standardantwort.
BETRÜGER!

data.review_body:
I have been using Temu, but my experience with this promotion has been extremely disappointing.

I participated in the “4 Gifts at £0” promotion, selecting four free items including recovery boots. I followed the instructions and placed the additional paid orders required by the promotion — one for around £15 and another for around £8.

The paid orders are clearly showing on my account and have been confirmed. However, when I contacted customer service about my four free gifts, I was told they could not find any record of the promotion.

I have now spent over an hour on live chat and have been passed between FIVE different agents. Each time I have had to explain the entire situation again, and apparently nobody can locate the free-gift promotion, despite me having screenshots proving that I selected the items.

This is incredibly frustrating. The paid orders can be found on my account, but somehow the promotion connected to those orders cannot be found.

I have not been given a proper explanation or resolution, and I am certainly not prepared to keep placing additional orders when I don’t even know whether I will receive the gifts I originally selected.

Temu needs to look seriously at how these promotions are being handled and improve its customer service. An hour of repeating the same problem to five different agents without anyone being able to resolve it is simply unacceptable.
Thank you for your response. I have received the Information Request Form.

However, after spending over an hour yesterday speaking to five different customer service agents, including a superior who ultimately told me he could no longer assist me, I am not prepared to spend another day going back and forth with customer service at this time.

What is particularly frustrating is that throughout the conversation I was repeatedly asked to provide my contact details and other information, which I provided each time as requested. Despite this, I was continually told that you could not find any record of the promotion or my free items.

What I find difficult to understand is that your agents were able to locate and confirm my paid orders on my account, yet apparently could not locate the free-gift promotion, even though the paid items and the promotional items were part of the same account/order activity.

I have already provided screenshots showing the “4 Gifts at £0” promotion and the items I selected, including the recovery boots. I have also followed the purchasing requirements I was given.

At this point, I simply need to step away from this situation as it has become unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. I will consider completing the Information Request Form at a later date, but I do not want to spend another day repeating the same information to different agents.

I hope that, when this is reviewed, someone will look properly at my account and order history and explain why my paid orders can be located and confirmed while the promotion associated with them apparently cannot.

Une honte absolue, fuyez ce site et leurs promesses en l'air. J'ai passé plus de deux heures sur le chat pour une commande de 121 € non livrée dans le délai de 4 jours garanti à l'achat. Hier soir à 20h30, la superviseuse Magdi s'est engagée formellement PAR ÉCRIT à me verser un "remboursement total" sur mon solde de crédit. C'était un mensonge délibéré uniquement pour me forcer à clore la discussion et soigner leurs statistiques de la soirée.Ce matin, mon solde est à zéro. Pire encore : j'ai eu affaire à trois conseillers différents (Malika et d'autres) qui m'ont littéralement coupé la parole et fermé le chat au nez à trois reprises, refusant d'honorer l'engagement écrit de leur propre collègue en prétendant qu'il s'agissait d'une "simple demande".C'est la DEUXIÈME fois que ce site applique cette stratégie frauduleuse sur mon compte (commande précédente reçue avec plus de 20 jours de retard et promesse de remboursement jamais tenue). C'est une pratique commerciale trompeuse réitérée (Art. L121-2 du Code de la consommation) et un mépris total du client. Mon dossier complet avec toutes les captures d'écran des chats est transmis à la DGCCRF via SignalConso ce jour.
MISE À JOUR DU 18 AOÛT : Temu vient de me faire une réponse automatique standard pour sauver les apparences en public. Je refuse de retourner sur votre chat général pour perdre à nouveau 3 heures face à des agents bridés informatiquement qui confirment ne rien pouvoir faire. L'engagement de remboursement total de 121 € a été pris par écrit par votre superviseuse Magdi hier soir à 20h30. Si votre équipe de gestion des litiges Trustpilot veut réellement résoudre cette situation, contactez-moi directement via la messagerie privée de cette plateforme pour créditer mon compte. Le signalement SignalConso reste actif.

data.review_body: Most items I've ordered were good quality. I've only had one instance where my order was late, and they automatically gave me a $5 credit for the delay. I think once I wrote a review about something that broke after a day and got an automatic refund, even though I didn't even request one. However, they have become increasingly deceptive. For example, I remember being able to purchase a minimum of $25 for 6 free gifts, and I was pretty happy. Now, the same deal would ask you to order about $200 more after your initial "minimum spend," and that might be lowballing. I recently tried to go through a promotion called "starsgift000," where you earn 90% back of what you spend in "stars." It suggested that I needed 60-something stars, so I only needed to spend a little over $63 in order to receive the free items. I read the rules a few times before spending $75 only for 3/8 of my gifts to be "earned." The required spending went from 60-something to 100-something stars. So, I contacted customer service, and the AI was SO bad. It just threw a $5 credit at me and repeated the same thing over and over about the rules. So, I asked for a real person. The first guy sent me to someone else, and she told me the requirement was actually 303 stars. So, THREE TIMES more than the promotion said. When I showed her the inconsistencies on my end, she admitted it was weird and escalated me to management. I cancelled the order because I realized they were taking a long time to respond. All I wanted to ask them was what my actual star requirement was. They proceeded to tell me that I needed to report post-purchase, which I DID, and they only repeated the same thing about the rules. It's always a different person replying too? I have struggled for DAYS asking straightforward questions and getting no answer. I lost the promotion over it, too. I have now waited 10 hours after complaining to them about customer service. I'm hoping they'll give me more credit for this "inconvenience" they've caused, but I doubt it. I'm VERY angry at Temu's customer service and inability to answer questions about their own promotions. They won't even say how minimum spends are calculated, either. I tried asking. Customer service needs to be WAY more transparent about promotions, and employees (apparently including management) need to be educated enough to actually provide answers to simple questions. The AI also needs to be reworked into an actual chatbot rather than linear answers, but I'm sure that's on purpose so it doesn't actually tell you anything you need to know! It's very obvious they're either being deceptive or just don't read a word you say. Or maybe they're not human? I don't know. I do believe customer service IS human, and they are very kind people, but when it's elevated past regular customer service, it's EXTREMELY hard to tell. I mean, how does management not even know anything about their OWN promotions and then can't provide a single answer for ANYTHING? I don't understand. I'm just frustrated.
data.review_headline: Deceptive, Frustrating, and Extremely Ignorant Customer Service

Uso temu da tantissimi anni, mi sono sempre trovata benissimo, l'ho consigliato a tante persone, che poi hanno comprato gli stessi prodotti che avevo comprato io. 
È anche vero che nell'ultimo anno mi ha dato solo problemi. 
Finte consegne senza rimborso perché " devono verificare" e hanno dato fiducia al corriere SCONOSCIUTO, e non a me cliente fidata. Ho chiesto di mostrarmi la firma di chi aveva ricevuto il pacco ma mai ricevuta. Comunque niente rimborso. 
Credito trovato nell'account ma non scalato al momento dell'ordine. 
Promozioni pubblicizzate, prodotti scelti e poi è arrivato quello che loro volevano e non scelto da me. 
La qualità dei prodotti adesso è sempre più scadente. 
Lavorando nel turismo e nel commercio, sono abituata a errori e finte lamentele, così ho voluto dare ancora fiducia. 
Ho acquistato un completo venduto come lino 100% ed è arrivato 95 poliestere e 5 elastane. 
Ho chiesto il reso e meraviglia delle meraviglie, devo portarlo io all'ufficio postale. Ma stiamo scherzando??? Un loro errore e io devo pagare??? Oltretutto sono in zona turistica e non dispongo di uffici postali raggiungibili a piedi e non ho la possibilità di fare il reso. 
Ho sentito più volte il customer care con il risultato cheo lo porto o perdo il reso. 
Conclusione. 
Temu ERA buono , adesso è una Presa in giro, ingannevole anche per come presenta i prodotti sul sito. 100% lino e più mi ritrovo un poliestere? E non viene neanche incontro nel reso??? 
Per me dovrebbe CHIUDERE in Italia la vendita online.

data.review_body:
BUYER BEWARE--I've had an absolutely horrible experience with this company. They literally stole money from me for a purchase I didn't approve or make, sent me an item that was packaged so poorly there were pieces missing, and their customer service is an absolute joke! 

I've contacted their customer service half a dozen times to try to get my money back (the first time right after VENMO notified me a charge was made), and they've done absolutely nothing but run around with one excuse after another. They first refused to cancel the order when I contacted them within hours to let them know I never authorized it----they then refused to allow a return (even though I was promised this as a resolution) until a "team" reviews my request with NO deadline or rush---and they have outright refused dozens of times to give me my money back! 

I followed a link to their site--spun a stupid wheel and "won" $350 in "free cash"! What a joke! They then put up a screen full of items and told me to pick my "free" item! I was intrigued, and chose a stupid $66 toy train but deliberately put it in my cart so I could come back later and research the train AND the "free" offer, and then left the site. A few hours later I received a notification from VENMO that I'd been charged full price for a toy I NEVER agreed to buy! I contacted TEMU immediately to tell them I never ordered it and they basically said "Oops! Too bad. It's already been shipped so can't cancel it!" I had to wait to receive it so I could return it?? But, now that it's arrived in a complete mess with pieces missing--they don't want to take it back!!! So I'm now stuck with a toy I never ordered or wanted, has missing pieces--including the actual TRAIN!, doesn't work, and they get to keep my $66?? 

And, just FYI--customer service is a JOKE! They take an hour of your time on chat to basically say and do nothing! They'll send your case to a "team" that you'll never hear from after the initial "we're here to help" email--all the while giving polite, cliche', robotic messages until you finally give up completely. 

I HATE this company!

EDIT#1:  Once again, TEMU replied with their usual statement pre-scripted, bogus  reply. Today is the 29th and the only thing I’ve heard from the “team” are two emails also full of the below, pre-scripted responses saying absolutely nothing and resolving absolutely nothing.  
They stole money from my Venmo account for an item I never ordered or wanted and refuse to take it back after they delivered it damaged with missing pieces.
How are they still in business? 
It’s been almost a month and they refuse to admit their mistake and refund my money! They also won’t take their item back!
They’re scamming people and doing it with a smile on their face!

Rueckerstattung
Ich habe jetzt schon einige Bewertungen ueber Temu abgegeben und moechte heute eine weitere hinzufuegen.
Ich hatte Anfang Juli eine Bestellung aufgegeben und zwar diesmal fuer einen recht hohen Betrag- ueber 77€,aber zum angegebenen Zeitpunkt war  mein Paket immer noch nicht da!!  Jedenfalls habe ich mir sehr grosse Sorgen gemacht, weil mir das noch nie bei Temu passiert ist!!! Unzaehlige Male habe ich DHL und verschiedene Zollstellen angerufen, aber das Paket blieb verschwunden. Erst da hatte ich mich an Temu wegen einer Rueckerstattung gewandt. Wobei ich sehr grosse Zweifel hatte, dass es damit klappt. Einmal hatte ich sowas noch nie gemacht und dann hatte ich die vielen negativen Bewertungen darueber gelesen... Ich wurde aber eines besseren belehrt. Der Kundenservice war sehr hilfsbereit gewesen und hat mir ohne Probleme sofort eine Rueckerstattung angeboten und Temu hat mir das Geld immerhalb von ein paar Tagen ueberwiesen, was mich sehr beeindruckt und gefreut hat. Somit konnte ich einen Grossteil der verloren gegangen Sachen wieder neu kaufen. 
Jedenfalls nochmal ganz vielen bei den Mitarbeitern des Kundenservice und bei Temu !!!!! Ganz grosse Klasse!! Natuerlich bestelle ich auch weiterhin bei Temu, auch wenn mal ein Paket verloren gegangen ist. Sehr schade um die schoenen Sachen, aber sowas kann eben mal passieren. Wobei ich hoffe, dass es eine Ausnahme bleibt?! Denn so toll auch die Rueckerstattung war, so ist es doch zehnmal schoener, wenn ich meine Pakete mit den Sachen erhalte. Wie schon gesagt, gefallen mir die Sachen von Temu stets sehr gut und ich kaufe  auch dort  stets gerne ein !!!!!!!

data.review_body: Review Title:Stalled by "Senior Specialist" loop for a lost package—switching to Amazon or eBayReview Body:I am writing this review out of pure frustration with Temu’s broken customer support system. My package shows as "delivered" on the system, but it was absolutely not received. I have followed all standard procedures, but instead of resolving the issue, I am being stalled with automated loops.My order number is PO-210-07316049902710457 and my active support ticket is ID: 1785525730210032.Every time I reach out for a status update, customer service tells me they have "escalated it to a senior specialist team." This is clearly a delay tactic to avoid issuing a refund for goods never received. Despite the fact that the GPS coordinates, a delivery photo etc showed clearly it was not delivered to my address, instead of protecting a customer, I am left with no items and no money. If you want a reliable online shopping experience where customer protection actually exists, avoid Temu. Save yourself the headache and use Amazon or eBay. When an item goes missing on Amazon or eBay, their customer service handles it instantly without forcing you through endless "specialist" tiers. My temu experience was a terrible one.

Nach einem nicht so heftigen Winter mit eher wenig Schnee und dem Frühjahr, das ja auch nicht so besonders war, zeigt das Zelt jetzt erheblichen Verschleiß auf der Plane und hat auch bereits Risse an den Ösen. Uns ist schon klar gewesen, dass das Zelt nicht ewig halten kann für den Preis, aber zumindest 2 Jahre wäre zu erwarten, wenn man der Beschreibung glauben möchte.
 
Ich habe dazu den Service angeschrieben und bemängelt, dass das Zelt entgegen der Beschreibung dass die Plane allen Elementen trotzt und eben nicht einmal ein Jahr hält.
Der Support hat leider jegliche Gewährleistung oder Kulanz abgelehnt mit der Begründung, dass die After-Sales-Frist bereits abgelaufen ist. Dass es aber nicht einmal ein Jahr her ist, dass das Zelt aufgebaut wurde, interessiert nicht.
 
Also auf keinen Fall mehr etwas bei Temu bestellen, insbesondere was dem Wetter ausgesetzt ist.
Wir werden bei Temu definitiv nichts mehr bestellen.
 
Es stimmt einfach, wer billig kauft, kauft meist zweimal.

data.review_body:
Utilizzo Temu da anni per un sacco di cose utili e anche per farmi piccoli regali. Sinceramete mi sono sempre trovata bene: dalle pantofole calde alle ciabatte da piscina, da materiale per bricolage a prodotti per piccoli lavori fai da te di manutenzione casa e auto , dalla statuetta di plastica all'accessorio da massaggio, tappetino pc, scodella rialzata per il cane, tagliere in acciaio, cuscino per cervicale, il doccino pressurizzato, eccellenti ricambi specifici filtro aspirapolvere praticamente a prezzo di fabbrica e chi più ne ha più ne metta. Non ho mai avuto problemi, le comunicazioni sono sempre state puntuali, il servizio di tracciamento e consegna è eccellente. Bisogna leggere bene le informazioni del venditore sotto le fotografie e le recensioni degli acquirenti. Sinceramente, per quanto mi riguarda, il gioco vale la candela. Solo una volta in anni di acquisti sono rimasta delusa, ma non avevo letto le informazioni del venditore che diceva chiaramente che quell'oggetto era di Materiale: plastica (e non acciaio)... del resto, avrei anche potuto immaginarlo che per 1 euro neanche Temu può vendirti un rompigetto decente, ma per 2,50 alla fine l'ho trovato e in acciaio inox.
Come per qualsiasi altro megastore online non tutte le occasionissime sono un affare, ma Temu è uno spasso navigarlo e qualcosa di valido a prezzi incredibilmente accessibili trovi sempre.
P.S. non mi risulta che non sia possibile criticare un prodotto o un negozio, ci sono eccome le valutazioni con 1 o 2 stelle e le osservazioni dei clienti delusi, nei limiti di una osservazione personale di ottimizzazione utile a tutti.
data.review_headline: Troppo per poco non è un affare

Het is opvallend, dat bij vele fotos van een product soms erg kunnen verschillen. Als dit het geval is, let dan goed op de foto waarbij het product het slechtst weergegeven wordt,slechte kwaliteit van wat dan ook.

In de meeste gevallen is het "dit" wat je thuis ontvangen zult.

Er worden bij Temu ongelooflijk veel imitatie- en namaakproducten aangeboden. Laat je dus niet misleiden door mooie productfoto’s, lovende teksten of claims over kopersbescherming. In de praktijk kun je in veel gevallen simpelweg je geld kwijt zijn.

Bedrukte shirts zijn daar een goed voorbeeld van. De foto’s zien er vaak prachtig uit, maar blijken regelmatig bewerkte afbeeldingen te zijn waarop het ontwerp digitaal is gemonteerd. Het daadwerkelijke shirt kan vervolgens gemaakt zijn van extreem dunne stof of ronduit slechte kwaliteit. Ook de maatvoering klopt vaak niet. Waar je normaal maat L draagt, kan het bij Temu zomaar nodig zijn om XL of zelfs XXL te bestellen.

Mijn advies: wees zeer terughoudend met elektronica en producten waarbij veiligheid of kwaliteit belangrijk is. Koop bijvoorbeeld geen batterijen, zonnecelverlichting, namaakplantjes of vergelijkbare producten zonder eerst zeer kritisch naar de kwaliteit en herkomst te kijken. Het aanbod is enorm en de verschillen in kwaliteit zijn dat ook.

Er zijn overigens ook producten die doorgaans prima bruikbaar zijn. Denk aan eenvoudige keukenartikelen zoals spatels, lepels en ander keukengerei, maar ook aan plastic zakjes en elastische kunststof afdekkingen voor kommen en borden. Dit zijn simpele massaproducten waarbij je minder afhankelijk bent van ingewikkelde techniek of hoogwaardige materialen.
Maar let vooral op de uiteindelijke prijs. Controleer vóórdat je bestelt heel goed wat je daadwerkelijk moet betalen. Bij Temu kunnen verschillende producten afzonderlijke verzendkosten met zich meebrengen. Die kosten worden vervolgens bij elkaar opgeteld, waardoor een bestelling die aanvankelijk goedkoop lijkt, uiteindelijk aanzienlijk duurder kan uitvallen.

Kortom: Temu is niet per definitie waardeloos, maar je moet er wel met gezond verstand winkelen. Laat je niet verleiden door spectaculaire foto’s, extreem lage prijzen en mooie verkooppraatjes. Kijk naar de daadwerkelijke kwaliteit, beoordelingen, maatvoering en vooral naar het totale bedrag dat uiteindelijk van je rekening gaat.

data.review_body:
Avoid this site if you are buying high-value items. I purchased an ASUS RTX 5070 graphics card (Order PO-069-15134025623673523) that arrived defective. I strictly followed the return process and dropped off the package via DPD (Tracking 13499345516553N). The official DPD receipt clearly proves a drop-off weight of 1.68 kg (the exact weight of the graphics card and packaging).

The third-party seller committed a blatant fraud: they peeled off my DPD shipping label and stuck it onto a completely different box filled with books to claim I returned the wrong item! The seller's own photos show a different box with 3 layers of stacked shipping labels.

Customer support is an absolute disgrace:

Automated bots sending copy-pasted refusal templates without reviewing the evidence.

A supervisor (Jinwoo) who assured me in writing that an "alternative solution" would be provided, only to arbitrarily close my ticket without issuing a refund!

This is shielding a fraudulent seller. An official report has been filed with the French Fraud Prevention Authority (DGCCRF / SignalConso), and a chargeback for fraud is underway with my bank.

Temu protects dishonest sellers instead of refunding a loyal customer who holds official carrier proof. Stay away.
data.review_headline: Merchant Scam Covered by Customer Support: Stolen Graphics Card (SignalConso Escalation)

It only worked by plugging it into the cigarette lighter and the flimsy cord was too short to reach all the tires.  I promptly returned the item, as instructed.  After 3 weeks I get an email advising that since "I didn't return the item" there would be no refund.  I know Temu offers cheap prices but they just want to move product.  A classless outfit to do business with.  They care about as much about treating customers fairly as poachers do about  protecting wildlife.  I remedied my problem by going to Harbor Freight and got EXACTLY what was advertised.
Tom

data.review_body:
Änderung 2.9.26. Als Lieferdienst wurde nun bei der zweiten Bestellung der Ware, bei der J&T beim ersten Versuch angebliche nicht meine Adresse finden konnte und das Paket zurück geschickt hat, DHL als Zulieferer genommen und da ich Rabatt und Gutscheine bekommen habe für den Stress und DHL nun zuverlässig und flexibel lieferte, bin ich nun wieder zufrieden mit Temu.

Ich bestelle dort nicht so oft. Meistens wenn es dort Produkte gibt, die es nirgendwo sonst gibt. Ich war eigentlich bis jetzt sehr zufrieden mit Temu, mit den Produkten und dem Service. 

Aber nun (im August 2026) wird der Lieferdienst J&T Express für die Lieferung beauftrag und das ist der Horror, wenn man guten und zuverlässigen Service von deutschen Lieferdiensten gewohnt ist. Man wird von diesem Lieferdienst nicht informiert, wann das Paket kommt und auch nicht, ob sie dagewesen sind. Ich wartete extra zu Hause aber niemand kam. Man kann auch keinen anderen Liefertag festlegen und es gibt keine Shops, wo diese Pakete hinterlegt werden, falls man nicht zu Hause sein kann. Ich wartete 10 Tage, ohne dass jemand kam und bekam nun die Information, dass das Paket wieder nach China zurückgeschickt wird. Grund: "address not found". Was eigentlich nur bedeutet, die Mitarbeiter von J&T Express können nicht lesen oder hatten keine Lust zuzustellen. Ich habe mein Geld erstattet bekommen aber das ganze Erlebnis hat mich 10 Tage extrem gestresst. Man wartet sowieso eine Weile auf seine Ware durch den Transport. Temus Service Mitarbeiter konnten mir leider nicht versichern, das nächstes mal einen anderen Lieferdienst beauftrag wird, was bedeutet, dieser Horrortrip kann beim nächsten mal auch wieder passieren. Viele Menschen arbeiten daran, dass die Ware eingesammelt wird, verpackt wird, verschickt wird, sie wird um die halbe Welt geflogen, muss durch den Zoll und dann scheitert es daran, dass die Mitarbeiter von J&T Express inkompetent sind und sie kein Plan B haben, wenn Menschen nicht zu Hause sind. Dieses Transportunternehmen zerstört Temus Business
data.review_headline: Temu ist gut, der Lieferdienst J&T -Express der Horror

data.review_body:
I've replaced much of my wardrobe, the prices on Temu tempted me so I bought shirts, jumpers, trousers, a coat, shoes, a shower head and hose. 
The clothing is good quality, well made and exactly as described, the shoes are as expected, lighter than I imagined but everything was as described and arrived on time. Everything is a perfect fit too. 
Depending on what you buy and where it comes from, delivery can be a few days to a few weeks, but everything came within the time limit from Temu. 
Yes there's quite a bit of click bait, you don't have to click it though  I did and I got my free gift. 
If you sign up for emails, they email you with all kinds of offers, discount codes (with time limits) and more click bait, you can unsubscribe anytime but keep an eye on your promotion emails, you might have more offers there too. 
I have not had the need to contact customer services as I'm more than happy with my purchases.
I have ordered things, then found something else I would prefer, I cancelled a couple of items and replaced them with something similar and received a refund/credit within an hour. Money refunds to your card takes 5-7 days but that's pretty much standard. I took refunds to my Temu account and it was instant.

Ich bestelle dort regelmäßig seit Jahren die Ware ist immer gut angekommen, Rückerstattungen haben bisher immer gut funktioniert ohne Probleme manchmal musste ich die Ware gar nicht zurücksenden, was ich gut finde ist diese Option auf "Preisanpassung" klicken zu können und dort bekommt man sogar ein Guthaben im Wert von wie viel der Preis von dem Produkt gesunken ist dass man bestellt hat, das geht glaube ich nur innerhalb eines Monats nach Bestellung es verkaufen dort mehrere verschiedene private und gewerbliche Verkäufer wenn man sich auch dafür anmelden kann, Produkte gleichen meistens den Produktbildern die Größenangaben stehen auch dort mit Abmessungen von Kleidung, Kleider halten mich mittlerweile schon knapp drei Jahre und sind in sehr gutem zustand farben werden nicht ausgewaschen,nicht alle aber manche Spielzeuge könnten etwas hochwertiger sein aber man kann nicht zu viel erwarten, die Lieferung dauert zwischen 3 - ca 12 Tage je nachdem was man wo bestellt die Qualität ist gut die meisten Sachen sind wirklich robust und stabil auch Sachen aus Metall oder Plastik, Bücher oder Stifte auch Schuhe, vor allem Kinderschuhe haben uns über den Winter sehr gut gehalten ohne kaputt zu gehen obwohl sie regelmäßig benutzt werden auch Elektrogeräte haben bisher keinen Mangel aufgewiesen. Selbst Lebensmittel wie Süßigkeiten oder Nahrungsergänzungsmittel und Heilpflanzen Kapseln sind in sehr gutem Zustand angekommen. Bestellungen werden gut bearbeitet und man wird auf dem Laufenden gehalten
Das einzige was ich vielleicht bei meinen würde sind die Aktualisierungen mit den zufuhrgebühren dann passt der Preis im Warenkorb nicht mehr sondern wenn man zur Kasse geht zur Bezahlung wird der Preis höher

Just don't waste your time or hard earned money on this company. They are charlatans offering you promotions and free gifts that they don't honour. 

Spinned and won 4 free gifts yes I believed the hype. Added an extra couple paid for items into my basket, paid, no order acknowledgement. Thought I'd check on their App to seey order and guess what, yup you guessed it, they only sent items I'd paid for!! So I went onto chat, spoke to a robot A I sh*t and then another two agents, after many messages back and forth and offers of credits to my Temu account, (I mean who is going to trust them again to purchase). They eventually in three refunds, refunded my £24.04p. I told the agent who to be fair did what they are instructed to do to the letter, be consilatory, be empathetic, offer small refund of credits, be even more consilatory, then offer small refund, and eventually after very firm messages I got a refund. But it is exhausting. They must pay their agents peanuts to warrant three being on the end of a credit of £24.04p. I did say that. So be aware don't fall for the spins, free coupons, free gifts it is all a ploy. On your head be it.
data.review_headline: Just don't waste your time please 🙏

Worst customer service ever experienced. Templated answers - no acknowledgement of your messages at all. AI could do better than these customer service agents!
Evri geolocked my address as I live up a farm lane - farm lane is fine to drive up and recently resurfaced anyway. Amazon, Royal Mail, DHL, Local couriers - no problem. Evri? "Cant' find addresss" and "Address Geo locked"  - think you can get any sort of sense from them? They even agreed to reship using another couriere- and then did so - and used Evri again - resulting in the getting to the end of the lane and "Can't find address". One driver did leave a parcel once (from Evri) which I found - wet. Lucky was ok -no information that they had though.  Both Temu and Evri have been abosolutely hopeless to deal with. And if you live in a rural area or up a track - and they refuse to deliver - don't expect any sense out of anyone at Temu or Evri. When I punch in my tracking number at Evri  - all I get is "Sorry we are having technical difficulty" and line goes dead. Utterly useless companies. (In my experience anyway). Never known anything quite like it.

⭐- 0/5 - Terrible Support and Bad Choice of Courier 

I am extremely disappointed with Temu because of their delivery partner J&T Express.
My package has been marked "out for delivery" for almost 2 days and it never arrived. 

What is worse is that J&T Express has no customer service. No phone works. No email reply.
I reached out to Temu support  24+ hours ago and they did nothing. Just robotic answers Complete silence. 

Temu should be responsible for who they hire to deliver.
By using J&T Express, Temu is showing they do not respect their customers' time. 

This is not 1990. This is 2026 and we expect basic tracking and support.
It has been 2 days "out for delivery" as if it was on a person delivering on a horse. 

I will warn all my friends and family to avoid Temu until they change couriers.
Avoid this company if you value your time and your orders. 

I will not order from Temu again until they stop using J&T Express.
I strongly advise everyone to avoid Temu if you don’t want your package stuck with no help from support. 

File a complaint about J&T Express. You will have a bad experience because of them.

Update 
No solution until now your service support just watching and make customer 
You're making a customer suffer with a delivery company you're responsible for. It's been four days and there's still no solution. I strongly advise against dealing with you because of this delivery company and your robotic customer service. Did I pay you or the delivery company? I didn't pay to suffer like this alone with a delivery company you chose. It's truly outrageous. This is the last time I'll deal with you. I strongly advise people to avoid you if you value your time and consider your customers important.

Temu denied my refund for the shoes that I returned: I have photographs and videos showing the items and how they were packaged for return, along with return and delivery documentation. Temu denied the refund without providing the warehouse evidence or inspection records I requested. I purchased a pair of shoes from Temu. However, Temu did not send the complete or correct pair. The shipment contained an individual shoe, that looked nothing like the photo.

I opened a return through Temu and returned the individual shoe exactly as they were received. Before shipping the return, I took photographs and videos showing the items, their condition, and how the shoe was packaged. The return was delivered to Temu’s designated return facility on July 27th, as confirmed by the return tracking information.

Temu subsequently denied my refund of $8.28, despite the photographic and video evidence I submitted. Temu did not provide any clear or verifiable evidence showing that the returned items were missing, incorrect, altered, or otherwise ineligible for a refund. In fact, the warehouse image Temu provided appears to show its employee holding the two separately bagged shoes, which is consistent with my documentation and confirms that the returned items reached Temu’s facility.

I contacted Temu and requested that the matter be properly reviewed, but the company continued to deny the refund without adequately explaining how my return failed to meet its requirements. Temu currently has both the returned merchandise and the money I paid. Don't expect a refund, expect to be scammed. (Update: They told me that they don't need to provide any evidence that they received the item that I returned, and that they won't issue me a refund. Useless and scamming company, I will be filing a dispute with my proof and documents. Don't believe them when they say "We're currently investigating" like they did in the reply. They are NOT. all they do is make you wait for a few days making you believe they are investigating something just to give you that same copy and paste response. I have already reported them for scam and fraud.)

data.review_body: UPDATE (August 18, 2026): Absolute circus, fraud, and clear incompetence by agents Jeff, Lucy, and Caitlyn regarding my order PO-186-01483704556152325!They didn't even bother to check my pictures! Caitlyn sent a ridiculous email claiming that a completely smashed, deformed crystal lamp with a crushed box "just needs to be assembled by hand by the customer"! It is pure incompetence—she clearly refused to look at the photos of the completely destroyed box and dented metal frame.Before this, Jeff closed my ticket and tried to trick me into canceling my original return request so I would lose my consumer rights. Now, Lucy and Caitlyn secretly opened a NEW ticket to cover up their team's mistakes.Caitlyn claims the system mistakenly opened an "Item not received" claim because I mentioned Spain and Romania. That is a flat-out LIE! I have a screenshot explicitly telling the agent NOT to open that claim because the package was delivered. They ignored me on purpose to setup an automatic rejection. They also claim a domestic GLS Romania label is valid for Spain, which is logistically impossible.Lucy, Caitlyn, and Jeff are just protecting incompetent agents (Jasmine, Sanchez, Zoe, Yolanda) from an official bank investigation. Temu is a pure scam!          ……………….                                                          I ordered a crystal candelabra lamp (order PO-186-01483704556152325), which arrived completely broken and shattered. What followed was a total nightmare of deceptive practices and mockery by Temu's customer support.First, when I reported the damaged item, the support agent opened a fake claim for "Item not received." Since tracking showed it was delivered to Spain, the system automatically rejected it. This was a deliberate setup to deny my refund.Second, after I protested, they promised a "refund without return" but instead forced a physical return and generated a label for GLS ROMANIA, completely ignoring that my shipping and residence address is in SPAIN! It is logistically impossible to ship broken glass across Europe using an invalid domestic label from another country.For over a week, the supervisor intentionally wasted my time by spamming me with useless automated templates. When I explicitly begged them to stop using templates and look at the country error, they mockingly replied with the exact same template script, word for word. No human empathy, no solutions, just wasting time.Finally, they tried to trick me by sending an email demanding that I cancel the return request and open a new one. This was a pathetic attempt to make me lose my consumer rights. Now, they have simply CLOSED the ticket without resolving anything.This is an absolute scam. I have already escalated this fraudulent behavior to my bank for a chargeback and filed an official case with the OCU Consumer Protection in Spain. Avoid Temu at all costs!

data.review_body:
Zeer teleurstellende en misleidende ervaring met Temu

Mijn ervaring met Temu is enorm tegengevallen. Wat aanvankelijk aantrekkelijk leek, voelde al snel als een opeenstapeling van misleidende aanbiedingen, spelletjes en marketingtrucs om je telkens opnieuw naar de app te lokken.

Bij mijn eerste aankoop kreeg ik de indruk dat ik meerdere cadeaus mocht uitkiezen. Uiteindelijk bleek dat je deze cadeaus eerst via een soort aankooppuntensysteem moest “verdienen”. Van de beloofde cadeautjes heb ik uiteindelijk slechts één gekregen. Bovendien bleek het cadeautje een piepkleine, eigenlijk onbruikbare miniatuurversie te zijn van wat in de aanbieding werd voorgesteld. Dat vind ik bijzonder misleidend.

Daarnaast word je voortdurend geconfronteerd met allerlei gokachtige spelletjes waarbij je zogezegd beloningen, cadeaus of extra kortingen kunt verdienen. Naar mijn mening wordt winkelen hierdoor onnodig omgevormd tot een soort spelmechanisme waarbij je telkens wordt aangespoord om nog iets te doen, te kopen of terug te komen. Zeker voor mensen die gevoelig zijn voor verslavende mechanismen vind ik dit erg zorgwekkend.

Ook de hoeveelheid e-mails is bijzonder storend. Bijna dagelijks krijg je berichten met zogezegde €1-deals of misleidende en sensationele titels zoals “Oh, we hebben het verprutst”, “Oeps, er ging iets mis”, “Gefeliciteerd, je hebt gewonnen” of “We hebben besloten om u te geven…”. De bedoeling lijkt vooral te zijn om nieuwsgierigheid op te wekken en je opnieuw naar de app te lokken.

Kortom: mijn vertrouwen in Temu is volledig verdwenen. De combinatie van misleidend overkomende aanbiedingen, spelletjes met beloningen, sensationele marketing en producten die niet overeenkomen met de gewekte verwachtingen heeft voor mij een zeer negatieve ervaring opgeleverd.

Voor mij was dit eenmalig. Ik koop nooit meer iets bij Temu.

data.review_body:
I'm very sorry to have to write this review. I've been ordering from Temu for years and generally had a good experience, but since they switched to J&T for deliveries, the process has become far too stressful.

I recently ordered several items, including a custom order, for an important event. Unfortunately, delivery was never even attempted. Despite this, J&T claimed that I had refused the package and sent it back to the sender.

The Temu representatives I spoke with via live chat were kind and friendly, and I appreciate their efforts. However, the only resolution they were able to offer was a refund plus a 20% discount coupon, capped at €20 and valid for just seven days. Considering the circumstances, this does not come close to making up for the situation. The order included a custom-made item, and because of the delay and return, I no longer have enough time to reorder it elsewhere before the event.

After being a customer for years, I'm genuinely disappointed that this experience has made me decide not to order from Temu again. I would strongly advise Temu to reconsider working with J&T, as an unreliable delivery partner can completely undermine an otherwise positive customer experience.
data.review_headline: Temu was great until J&T delivery

You really do have to be careful – cheap doesn’t necessarily mean good. There are certainly some good, affordable products, but there’s also a lot of rubbish where the products look good in the photos and the description, but then don’t work as well in practice or are not of that material as you’d expect. Also, be aware of the many 5-star reviews: the comments often reveal whether the buyer is giving a genuine or useless review of the product or if he has really used the product. At least the refund process is straightforward if there is a problem with any product.

Providing such false product information is clearly misleading to customers. data.review_body:
Zeer teleurstellende ervaring – waardeloze klantenservice

Ik heb via Temu een zwevend walnoot tv-meubel besteld van €213, maar ik heb een compleet ander model ontvangen. Het meubel dat ik besteld heb, is bedoeld om aan de muur te hangen. Het meubel dat ik heb ontvangen heeft poten en kan niet op de manier worden gemonteerd waarvoor ik het heb gekocht.

Maar het meest frustrerende aan deze ervaring is de klantenservice.

Ik heb meerdere keren uitgelegd wat er is gebeurd en foto's meegestuurd waarop duidelijk te zien is dat ik het verkeerde product heb ontvangen. Het meubel was bovendien al voor ongeveer 75% gemonteerd voordat ik ontdekte dat het om een verkeerd model ging. Logisch ook, want ik ging er natuurlijk vanuit dat ik het product had ontvangen dat ik besteld had.

Ik heb de klantenservice vervolgens meerdere keren dezelfde simpele vraag gesteld: als ik het verkeerd geleverde meubel voorzichtig uit elkaar haal en terugstuur, krijg ik dan alsnog mijn volledige bedrag van €213 terug?

Maar in plaats van deze concrete vraag te beantwoorden, krijg ik steeds vrijwel hetzelfde standaardantwoord dat ik het product moet retourneren om een volledige terugbetaling te krijgen.

Het voelt eerlijk gezegd alsof ik met een robot praat in plaats van met een klantenservicemedewerker. Er wordt totaal niet ingegaan op wat ik daadwerkelijk vraag.

Ze hebben mij €64  aangeboden als ik het verkeerde meubel houd, terwijl ik €213 heb betaald voor een compleet ander product. Wanneer ik uitleg waarom dit geen redelijke oplossing is, krijg ik vervolgens weer een standaardreactie waarin staat dat ik het product moet retourneren.

Temu needs to stop using SpeedX
I have enjoyed ordering from Temu, but I am extremely disappointed that Temu continues to use SpeedX for deliveries. My package was marked “Attempted Delivery — No Access” even though my driveway was completely clear and accessible, and no one actually attempted to deliver my package.
Now, because of SpeedX’s failure to deliver, I am being told I have to wait several more days for another attempt.
Customers should be allowed to choose their delivery carrier at checkout, especially when certain carriers repeatedly provide poor service. I would genuinely rather have my order sent by snail mail than SpeedX — or as I call them, Speed 0.
If Temu continues using SpeedX without giving customers another delivery option, I will seriously reconsider ordering from Temu, and I will continue sharing my experience anywhere delivery-service reviews are accepted.
Temu, please listen to your customers. A good price means very little if the package cannot reliably make it to the customer's door.

Emne / Sag ID: 1371725233731465394 – Appel af afvist anmeldelseKære Temu-team,Jeg appellerer hermed jeres afgørelse om ikke at fjerne den anmeldte vare.Jeg har købt Gillette Mach3 barberblade (både en pakke med 10 stk og en pakke med 3 stk) på Temu. Jeg har sammenlignet de to pakker direkte:Den lille pakke med 3 stk fungerer acceptabelt.  
Pakken med 10 stk er ubrugelig. Bladene er ekstremt sløve, river og flår i skægget i stedet for at skære. Det medfører hudirritation, røde knopper og en meget ubehagelig barbering.

Jeg vedhæfter billeder af begge produkter. Det fremgår tydeligt, at der er tale om produkter med kinesisk emballage og tekst, som ikke lever op til den kvalitet, man forventer af et anerkendt mærke som Gillette.Dette er vildledende markedsføring og manglende overensstemmelse med beskrivelsen. Varerne opfylder ikke forbrugerens rimelige forventninger til et Gillette Mach3-produkt, jf. forbrugerkøbsloven og EU’s forbrugerregler.Jeg kræver derfor:Øjeblikkelig fjernelse af den pågældende vare fra Temu Danmark.
Refusion af mine køb (både den defekte 10-pakke og eventuelt de andre).
At I undersøger, om der er tale om kopivarer eller underlødige produkter, der vildleder danske forbrugere.

Hvis I ikke imødekommer denne appel, vil jeg:Indberette sagen til Forbrugerombudsmanden
Indberette til politiet vedrørende mulig vildledning
Søge udenretslig tvistbilæggelse efter Digital Services Act artikel 21

Jeg ser frem til en hurtig og positiv tilbagesendelse.Med venlig hilsen
Leif Tullberg

I am extremely unhappy with my experience with Temu and honestly feel let down as a customer.

I placed an order, paid for it, and waited for it to arrive. The tracking then stated that my parcel had been “delivered.” The problem is that I DID NOT RECEIVE MY ORDER. It was apparently left outside, unattended, without being handed to me or placed somewhere secure.

How can an order be considered successfully delivered when the customer has not received it?

I understand that delivery companies can have problems, but leaving a paid parcel outside and simply marking it as delivered is not an acceptable solution. Once a parcel is left unattended, it can easily disappear, be stolen, damaged by weather, or be taken by somebody else. The customer should not be expected to take responsibility for that.

I paid for my items in good faith and expected them to arrive safely. Instead, I am left without my order and having to deal with the frustration of contacting customer service and explaining something that should be very straightforward: I ordered it, I paid for it, and I did not receive it.

The fact that the tracking says “delivered” does not magically mean I received the package. There is a huge difference between a parcel being marked as delivered and a customer actually receiving it.

This has completely changed my opinion of Temu. Before this experience, I was willing to order from the platform, but now I have serious concerns about whether my orders will actually reach me safely.

Customers should not have to worry that their purchases will simply be left outside and potentially disappear. Temu needs to take delivery problems much more seriously and make sure customers are properly protected when an order is not received.

I am extremely disappointed and expect Temu to take responsibility for this situation and provide a proper resolution. I paid for an order that I never received, and that is simply not acceptable.

Based on this experience, I would seriously reconsider ordering from Temu again. Very poor experience and very frustrating customer service

data.review_body: Titolo: Temu viola la legge europea: trattiene il mio rimborso dal 2 luglio per un bug del suo sistemaTesto: Denuncio pubblicamente una gravissima trattenuta indebita di denaro e la violazione dei diritti del consumatore da parte di Temu. In data 02/07/2026 ho rispedito un reso per la pratica TEMU utilizzando l'etichetta prepagata internazionale fornita dalla piattaforma stessa. Il pacco è stato regolarmente accettato e preso in carico da Poste Italiane con codice di tracciamento nazionale CU105394625IT (Locker del Centro Commerciale di Curno, ore 05:35), come certificato dalla ricevuta ufficiale in mio possesso.Nonostante l'Articolo 1, Comma VI della policy ufficiale di Temu e il Codice del Consumo impongano il rimborso entro 14 giorni dalla semplice DIMOSTRAZIONE dell'avvenuta rispedizione, l'assistenza clienti fa un muro di gomma scandaloso. L'operatore Zet via email continua a inviare messaggi automatici affermando che l'etichetta risulta "annullata dal sistema perché il pacco non è stato consegnato nei tempi". È un palese ed evidente bug informatico del loro software: l'algoritmo ha annullato la pratica in automatico ignorando che il pacco è partito fisicamente un mese fa ed è nei loro circuiti logistici.Trattenere i soldi di un cliente per un errore del vostro software è un illecito. Esigo che un responsabile delle relazioni pubbliche prenda in carico questa recensione, verifichi il codice CU105394625IT ed emetta IMMEDIATAMENTE il rimborso manuale in deroga sul mio metodo di pagamento originale. In mancanza di un accredito immediato, lunedì mattina depositerò la ricevuta di Poste Italiane e le chat d'assistenza come denuncia formale all'AGCM (Antitrust Italiana) per pratiche commerciali scorrette e alla piattaforma ODR della Commissione Europea.

data.review_body: Jeg havde et problem med at en anden kunne tilføje mit telefonnummer til hans konto. Jeg kender ikke personen, og jeg har ikke sagt ja til at dette måtte ske. De først 2 gange får jeg af vide at fejlen ligger ved mig, at jeg ikke har sikret min konto, men 3 gang hvor der for først gang bliver kigget lidt mere ind i det, kommer det frem at det var en fejl i deres system, og aldrig har været en fejl fra min side af. De har bedt mig være tålmodig i 3 måneder, hvor de har sagt de undersøger sagen, og kompensationen. 70 kr kredit og 20% rabat på næste køb, den kompensation skrev de i de først 14 dage, og nu 3 måneder senere, hvor de skulle have undersøgt om de kunne gøre kompensation bedre, og kigget nærmere på fejlen, så det stadig det samme. De har ikke undersøgt noget som helst, de har holdt fast i deres “speciale tilbud” som de kaldte det, men et tilbud de giver til alle med problemer, spildt min tid, min tålmodighed, og har bare haft det sjovt med at behandle mig som det har passet dem.

In this review I need to mention both TEMU and EVRI,  since they are closely linked as the SELLER and the DELIVERY service they use. Given the seriousness of this situation I believe, not just EVRI,  but also TEMU has to take responsibility too, for contracting EVRI.  I was expecting a parcel from Temu. I had not received information on the delivery day, NOR a tracking number.  Yesterday, I got a call from a neighbour who had found the parcel addressed to me in our busy  street, OUTSIDE the 34 flat building where we live. The delivery service had not rang my flat via intercom, nor had s/he  contacted me via mobile, for me to open the main door. This is not the first time I have EXPERIENCED IT. Once the main door is opened, WITHOUT informing the recipient,  EVRI  leaves the parcels unattended in the lobby,  where at least 100 people (between workers, including cleaners, GPs, nurses, domestic assistants, and family visitors) transit every day. Soon after Evri sends a message saying "your parcel has been delivered" I wonder to whom?, trusting what?. DOES TEMU have a policy to send parcels to the BUILDING ADDRESS ONLY? DOES EVRI have a policy to deliver to a BUILDING ADDRESS or to the lobby ONLY? If so, they should informe it to customers. This unreliable delivery service, affects addressees, creates anxiety, and extra work. Do we need to be CHECKING THE STREET, and the ENTRANCE constantly?  or providing that  one  had  been lucky that time, RUNNING down the stairs, as soon as they say "parcel for you" via intercom.
 Many parcels have been lost in this way. TEMU should change the delivery service or EVRI CONTRACTS honest, dependeble workers.

data.review_body: I, like many shoppers, avoided Temu for years because I wasn't sure if it was legitimate. I now regret that. I finally succumbed, and I now use Temu regularly for buying supplies for my craft business. It really can't be beat. They have a huge variety of things at great prices, and for the most part the quality is good. I do think they have far too many wild games and promotions which really are just confusing to use, and are borderline fraudulent. However the price adjustment feature on orders is great. You can request a price adjustment on anything you order for up to 30 days from the time you order it and they'll give it to you, even if you do it every single day for 30 days. This can add up to a lot of credits. If you're going to use Temu, you need to learn how to request price adjustments. My only real complaint about Temu, and this is consistent among many different kinds of things I've ordered from them, they misrepresent the size of things, sometimes in the written dimensions and sometimes what they show in  pictures of the product. Usually things are smaller than they say they are. I've learned over time how much to assume  they are too small so that I order things that I need in the right size, but it's awkward and they really need to address that. I don't really understand why they take that approach though because most people know what size they need of a particular product and that's what they want and that's what they're expecting. It just leads to returns of items for refunds when you get something that is not the dimensions you need. I'm going to continue to use Temu. I hear people say they're Communist and they steal your data, and all this and that, but I figure data stealing is probably happening with anything I buy from anybody online, and I'm certainly not going to stop shopping online, the economic benefits are too good.
